papers.title: Offline Approximate Value Iteration: A Reinforcement Learning Approach for Satellite Constellation Deployment
papers.summary: This paper introduces a reinforcement learning-based approximate dynamic programming approach to optimize the deployment of Walker-type satellite constellations under uncertainties, including launch failures and satellite malfunctions. We formulate the problem as a Markov Decision Process that incorporates low-injection orbit launches, continuous low-thrust orbit raising, and variable satellite loads. We adopt the offline approximate value iteration solution method, using linear function approximation with basis functions and action pruning strategies to substantially reduce the computational and memory requirements for finding optimal decision policies. Preliminary results demonstrate convergence to policies with low expected costs and deployment times, both of which are lower than those of a rolling-horizon baseline, showcasing a novel application of approximate dynamic programming in space logistics.
papers.title_ja: オフライン近似価値反復：衛星コンステレーション展開のための強化学習アプローチ

papers.title: An intelligent satellite must do nothing well
papers.summary: Autonomous inspection of a resident space object is usually posed as a contest between classical next-best-view planning and reinforcement learning. We argue that the choice of algorithm is the least informative of the design axes. An inspector spacecraft has no rest state: when it stops thrusting, orbital dynamics carry it along a natural trajectory that can be used to observe the target at no fuel cost. On a controlled ladder in which one design axis is varied at a time, fuel efficiency turns out to be set by three things: whether the agent is allowed to drift, whether its state records where drifting has taken it, and whether its planning horizon is long enough for the benefit to appear. Removing any one of them doubles the fuel bill or more. The algorithm still matters, but through what it can represent: a model-based agent whose learned world model ignores fuel spends several times more of it. Finally, no learned policy is safe by construction, and a control barrier function filter beneath the decision layer removed every keep-out-zone violation in two thousand evaluation episodes.
papers.title_ja: 賢い衛星は、何もせず（ドリフト）をうまく活用すべきである
papers.summary_ja: 宇宙物体の自律点検において、アルゴリズムの選択よりも設計軸が重要であると主張する。推進を停止した際の軌道力学による自然なドリフトを活用することで、燃料コストを大幅に削減できることを示した。ドリフトの許可、状態記録、計画ホライズンの長さが燃料効率を決定づける3要素であり、これらを欠くと燃料消費が倍以上になる。また、学習済みポリシーの安全性を補完するため、制御バリア関数フィルタを用いて禁止区域への侵入を完全に排除した。

papers.title: Fast Fuel-Optimal Constrained Impulsive Control with Application to Distributed Spacecraft
papers.summary: This work extends a reachable set theory approach for fuel-optimal control to incorporate convex and non-convex state, time, and magnitude constraints. The solver is designed from a new set of optimality conditions, derived by reformulating a single reachable set into multiple time-ordered, step-wise reachable set waypoint sub-problems, where a waypoint is the state reached after a given maneuver. Non-convex constraints are satisfied at each waypoint, preserving convexity at each sub-problem without needing to convexify the full control problem, enabling the computationally efficient identification of constrained optimal maneuvers, and guaranteeing a user-defined bound on constrained cost. To produce an optimal maneuver plan, the solver rolls out constrained trajectories until the remaining unconstrained solution adheres to the problem constraints. The fuel-optimal control problem considered by this work is broadly applicable to many fields and particularly significant to Distributed Space Systems (DSS). Multi-agent guidance and propulsive control techniques, often for small spacecraft at close separations, require guarantees of collision avoidance, efficient maneuvering to preserve a restricted fuel payload, and numerically-simple algorithms functional under on-board computational processing limitations. The proposed solver offers both user-defined bounds on constrained maneuver optimality and enhanced computational efficiency to directly address these challenges, and these capabilities are demonstrated comparatively against baseline solvers from the literature through Monte Carlo analysis on a variety of relevant DSS scenarios. Overall, this work enables the benefits of reachable set theory, namely computational efficiency and provable optimality, to be extended to control problems of higher fidelity.
papers.title_ja: 分散宇宙機への応用を伴う、高速な燃料最適制約付きインパルス制御
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、到達可能集合理論に基づく燃料最適制御手法を拡張し、凸および非凸な状態・時間・大きさの制約を効率的に処理するソルバを提案する。単一の到達可能集合を時間順のウェイポイントサブ問題に再定式化することで、各サブ問題の凸性を保ちつつ非凸制約を満たし、計算効率と最適性の保証を両立させる。この手法は、衝突回避や燃料効率、オンボード計算リソースの制約下での動作が求められる分散宇宙システム（DSS）の多エージェント誘導・推進制御に特に有効である。モンテカルロ解析により、既存のベースラインソルバと比較して、制約付き機動の最適性境界と計算効率の向上を実証している。

papers.title: A heteroskedasticity and autocorrelation consistent test for process noise calibration of Kalman filters in multi-sensor orbit determination
papers.summary: Process noise calibration is a central problem in sequential orbit determination. If the process noise covariance is too small the filter is overconfident, and if it is too large it is overconservative. In both cases the estimation error grows and the reported covariance stops describing it, which affects downstream products such as conjunction assessment or re-entry prediction. No widely adopted method diagnoses the calibration in multi-sensor settings, where measurements of different type and dimension must enter a single consistency metric. This work presents the Heteroskedasticity and Autocorrelation Consistent Dimensionless Averaged Normalised Innovation Squared (HAC-DANIS) test, which evaluates process noise calibration from the innovation sequence of the filter, without ground truth. The normalised innovation squared (NIS) of each measurement is divided by its dimension, which puts sensors of any dimension on a common scale, and the standard error of the averaged sequence is obtained with the heteroskedasticity and autocorrelation consistent (HAC) Newey--West estimator, which accounts for the sensor-dependent variance of the sequence and for the serial correlation left by a miscalibrated filter or an imperfect dynamical model. Under mixing and moment conditions the statistic is asymptotically standard normal for a calibrated filter, and for a miscalibrated one its sign indicates the direction of the miscalibration. The autocorrelation function of the normalised sequence complements the test with a characterisation of the mistuning regime. Applied to an unscented Kalman filter processing simulated laser, telescope and radar observations of four satellites in low Earth orbit, the test rejects the eight miscalibrated process noise configurations with the sign of their miscalibration and does not reject the four calibrated with it.
papers.title_ja: マルチセンサー軌道決定におけるカルマンフィルタのプロセスノイズ較正のための異分散・自己相関一貫性テスト
papers.summary_ja: マルチセンサー環境下での軌道決定において、カルマンフィルタのプロセスノイズ較正を診断する新しい統計的テスト手法「HAC-DANIS」を提案する。この手法は、異なる次元や種類のセンサー観測値を共通の尺度に正規化し、Newey-West推定量を用いて異分散と自己相関の影響を補正することで、真値なしでフィルタの較正状態を評価する。理論的には、較正されたフィルタでは統計量が標準正規分布に従い、較正がずれている場合はその方向性を示す符号が得られることを示す。低軌道衛星のシミュレーションデータを用いた検証では、8つの不適切な較正設定を正しく検出し、4つの適切に較正された設定を棄却しなかった。

papers.title: Spectral and Conformal: Neural Network Methods for Calibrated Trajectory Prediction and Control-Point Intervals
papers.summary: Autonomous systems that navigate their environment need methods to quickly assess the feasibility and safety of desired trajectories. Traditional solutions that rely on numerical integration can be computationally heavy, while fast data-driven surrogates lack the formal guarantees that numerical approaches provide. This work demonstrates a framework that uses (1) a neural network with a spectral backbone to learn trajectories and quantile bands with built-in constraints (initial conditions and stability); (2) a modified conformal quantile regression to provide calibrated, joint trajectory-level coverage; and (3) interval arithmetic to extend noise-free coverage guarantees to control points. After refactoring the network for inference, the trajectory inference time for a quadrotor under a closed-loop linear quadratic regulator is 3.45~ms on a Raspberry Pi Zero 2 W. The total pipeline time, including trajectory inference time, is 9.81~ms, or approximately 100~Hz, consistent with typical control rates.
papers.title_ja: スペクトルと共形：校正された軌道予測と制御点間隔のためのニューラルネットワーク手法

papers.title: RaMMOBO: Random Max-Margin Multi-Objective Bayesian Optimization
papers.summary: Multi-objective Bayesian optimization (MOBO) maximizes $M$ expensive black-box objectives with the goal of approximating the Pareto set, whose objective vectors cannot be improved in one component without sacrificing another. A common quality measure is hypervolume, the volume in objective space dominated by these vectors relative to a reference point. Expected hypervolume improvement (EHVI) directly targets this metric and is one-step Bayes-optimal, but its standard computation scales exponentially with $M$, making it prohibitively expensive for many-objective problems. We introduce random max-margin multi-objective Bayesian optimization (RaMMOBO), whose acquisition function lower-bounds EHVI while requiring only linear cost in $M$ to evaluate. RaMMOBO measures the volume of a max-margin box contained in a candidate's hypervolume-improvement region and averages over random reweightings of the objective space, yielding a utility that is strictly Pareto-monotone on hypervolume-improving outcomes. It naturally handles noisy observations and different probabilistic surrogates and supports efficient gradient-based optimization. Across synthetic and real-world benchmarks, RaMMOBO matches or outperforms state-of-the-art methods, with largest gains at higher $M$, with acquisition optimization up to two orders of magnitude faster than qLogNEHVI. Our implementation is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/rammobo.
papers.title_ja: RaMMOBO: ランダム最大マージン多目的ベイズ最適化
papers.summary_ja: 多目的ベイズ最適化（MOBO）において、期待ハイパボリューム改善（EHVI）の計算コストが目的関数の数に対して指数関数的に増加する問題を解決する手法を提案する。本手法は、候補解のハイパボリューム改善領域に含まれる最大マージンボックスの体積を測定し、目的空間の重み付けをランダム化して平均化することで、EHVIの下界を線形コストで評価する獲得関数を構築する。このアプローチはノイズのある観測や異なる確率サロゲートモデルに対応し、勾配ベースの最適化も効率的に行える。合成データおよび実世界のベンチマークにおいて、既存手法と同等以上の性能を示し、特に目的関数が多い場合において獲得関数の最適化速度が最大2桁速いことを実証した。

papers.title: Learned Surrogates of Three-Dimensional Magnetohydrodynamic Turbulence
papers.summary: Three-dimensional magnetohydrodynamic (MHD) turbulence, the flow of astrophysical and fusion plasmas, is costly to simulate. We present, to our knowledge, the first learned surrogates of three-dimensional resistive MHD turbulence, and compare three standard backbones in that role: a convolutional UNet, a shifted-window transformer and a Fourier neural operator. They are trained as autoregressive emulators of decaying MHD turbulence at a resolution of $128^3$ and Reynolds numbers of 1000, 3000 and 6000, on 500 simulations per Reynolds number, each with one two-stage procedure, single steps and then short rollouts, and stopped by one rule. Over a window of about one large-eddy turnover time, the UNet and the transformer reach relative velocity errors of 0.018 to 0.053 and keep the current sheets, the enstrophy, the current density and the energy spectra of the simulation; which of the two is the more accurate depends on the Reynolds number, the UNet leading at 3000 and 6000 and the transformer at 1000. Applied with the same backbones and training procedure to two public benchmarks, the models reach the lowest error reported to date on the isotropic turbulence set of FactFormer, 39% below the best published model. On the compressible MHD set of The Well, their rollout errors are a third to a half below those of the best of The Well's baselines. They also match a 1.3 B-parameter pretrained foundation model in its rollout windows, with 20-62 times fewer parameters. The code, the configuration of every model, the evaluation scripts and the data generator with the seed of every simulation will be released upon publication.

papers.title: Large-Scale Bayesian Optimisation Using Uncertainty-Calibrated Product-of-Experts Gaussian Process Models with Trust Regions
papers.summary: The use of collections of independent local Gaussian processes (GP-ind) combined with trust regions is a widely adopted approach for large-scale and high-dimensional Bayesian optimisation (BO). However, this approach suffers from several limitations, including discontinuities at the boundaries of disjoint regions, an inability to capture long-range spatial correlations, potential information loss, and abrupt increases in computational overhead. To address these limitations, this paper introduces a novel BO algorithm, termed BO-pro-c-tr. The proposed method employs a product-of-experts Gaussian process model with uncertainty calibration (GP-pro-c) as its surrogate model and incorporates a one-to-many association strategy for integrating GP-pro-c with trust regions. Empirical results suggest that, when combined with the GP-LCB acquisition function, BO-pro-c-tr achieves an average reduction of 2.6% in simple regret and 34.9% in computational overhead relative to BO algorithms based on independent local GP models coupled with trust regions.

papers.title: Mesh2Shell Neural Operator for Inverse Shape Optimization
papers.summary: Physics-driven design seeks high-performing geometries, which need not conform to a learned shape category. Parametric and latent-space approaches facilitate surrogate-based optimization, but restrict deformations to prescribed shape families or learned decoders. We introduce the Mesh-to-Shell Neural Operator (M2S-NO) as the mesh-to-shell component of a category-agnostic inverse shape optimization framework. We separate the explicit mesh used for design from the volumetric representation used for physics prediction. M2S-NO maps oriented surface samples to a surface-centered shell representation, such as TruncatedSDF or HeatSDF. A separate problem-specific PDE neural operator (PDE-NO) maps this representation to physical fields. Objective gradients update mesh vertices through both operators, without a latent shape decoder. Preconditioning and remeshing support free-form deformation, while fixed interfaces are controlled directly on the mesh. Optional shell-space proposals enable topology changes. We evaluate geometric matching, jet-engine brackets, and neutron moderators, with independent FEM and OpenMC evaluation. Relative to the best training designs, M2S-NO reduces maximum bracket displacement by 14.3% and increases neutron-sensor current by 13.8%. Optimization also succeeds from an out-of-distribution bracket initialization, demonstrating the framework's geometric flexibility.

papers.title: Architecture-Aware Mixed Precision for Replica-Exchange Training of Geometry-Aware Neural Operators with Uncertainty Quantification
papers.summary: Geometry-aware neural operators face substantial computational and memory demands when learning across complex physical domains. We introduce Architecture-Aware Mixed Precision (AA-MP), a replica-exchange training strategy that allocates numerical precision according to replica roles and architecture-specific operations. By retaining FP32 for refinement while selectively employing BF16 for exploration, AA-MP preserves predictive accuracy while improving training efficiency. Across fluid dynamics and three-dimensional structural mechanics benchmarks, AA-MP achieves comparable accuracy to full-precision training over an ensemble of runs, while reducing hot-replica peak GPU memory by 46.9% and training time by up to 25.8%. It also outperforms naive Automatic Mixed Precision (AMP) in memory efficiency and computational cost, with increasing memory advantages at larger model and geometry scales. Ablation studies show that retaining FP32 in the cold-replica is important for predictive accuracy, while additional FP32 operations in the exploratory replica provide limited benefits relative to their computational cost. Finally, conformal prediction for uncertainty calibration shows that AA-MP achieves near-nominal coverage with narrower prediction intervals than the alternatives. These results advance the scalability of geometry-aware scientific machine learning by reducing computational costs without compromising predictive accuracy or uncertainty quantification.

papers.title: POD-CNF: reduced order modeling of parametrized stochastic PDEs via normalizing flows and proper orthogonal decomposition
papers.summary: Reduced-order models (ROMs) learned from trusted numerical simulations enable the real-time simulation of complex physical systems, making computationally prohibitive tasks-such as uncertainty quantification and optimal control-tractable. In particular, data-driven ROMs are opening the opportunity to learn from both numerical simulations and experimental data. However, integrating these sources of information is far from straightforward. Real-world measurements often involve multiple sources of uncertainty, including non-Gaussian noise, latent heterogeneities, unknown or hidden system parameters, and multiscale phenomena occurring below the resolution of the data. Consequently, real-world data are better described by parametrized stochastic partial differential equations, for which the development of effective ROMs remains relatively unexplored. In this work, we introduce POD-CNF, a data-driven generative ROM for efficient uncertainty quantification of parametrized high-dimensional systems. The approach combines projection-based model reduction and deep generative modeling. First, Proper Orthogonal Decomposition (POD) is employed to obtain a low-dimensional representation of the solution manifold. A Conditional Normalizing Flow (CNF) is then trained to approximate the density of the reduced coefficients conditionally on the input parameters. This formulation allows the surrogate to capture complex, multimodal output distributions, going beyond standard regression-based ROMs and least-squares predictions. We assess the effectiveness of POD-CNF through numerical experiments, demonstrating its ability to accurately reproduce output distributions while substantially reducing computational costs. Finally, a proof-of-concept application illustrates how the generative paradigm facilitates integration into Bayesian inverse problems, highlighting promising directions for future research.
papers.title_ja: POD-CNF: 正規化フローと固有直交分解によるパラメータ付き確率偏微分方程式の縮約モデル
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、パラメータ付き確率偏微分方程式（PDE）に対するデータ駆動型縮約モデル（ROM）「POD-CNF」を提案する。固有直交分解（POD）を用いて解の低次元表現を得た後、条件付き正規化フロー（CNF）を訓練し、入力パラメータに条件付けられた係数の確率密度を近似する。これにより、標準的な回帰ベースのROMでは捉えきれない多峰性や非ガウス分布を含む複雑な出力分布を効率的に再現できる。数値実験により計算コストの大幅削減と分布再現精度の両立を示し、さらにベイズ逆問題への適用可能性を実証している。

papers.title: SpecOPD: Branch-Parallel On-Policy Distillation for Speculative Decoding
papers.summary: Speculative decoding (SD) accelerates large language model inference by reducing the sequential cost of token-by-token generation. Advanced SD methods reduce proposal cost with parallel drafters that predict entire blocks in one forward pass, but overall speedup still depends on acceptance length. On-policy distillation (OPD) can push well-trained drafters beyond acceptance-length plateaus, yet conventional pipelines collect supervision through sequential draft-and-verify rollouts. Our key insight is that on-policy supervision need not inherit these dependencies: a draft block can be supervised using only its reference prefix and draft-sampled history. We propose SpecOPD, a branch-parallel OPD framework that parallelizes draft sampling and target supervision across independent branches drawn from the evolving drafter policy at reference anchors. We pack these branches into proposal trees to share target-prefix computation, using tree masks for full attention, branch-consistent indexer groups for sparse attention, and indexed state replay for linear attention to preserve each branch's history. We train the drafter with an E2E-TV surrogate that directly targets acceptance length. Our study spans 8B full-attention (GQA), 27B full-linear (GQA--GDN), and 125B sparse-linear (QSA--GDN) targets, three parallel draft architectures (DFlash, DSpark, and DFlash V2), and four task domains (dialogue, coding, mathematics, and agentic). SpecOPD achieves up to 41.45% higher mean acceptance length, $16.09\times$ supervised-token throughput over sequential-rollout OPD under native configurations, and up to $3.56\times$ generation speedup over autoregressive decoding.
papers.title_ja: SpecOPD: 投機的デコーディングのためのブランチ並列オンポリシー蒸留
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、大規模言語モデル（LLM）の推論高速化手法である投機的デコーディング（Speculative Decoding）におけるドラフタ（下書きモデル）の学習効率を向上させる手法「SpecOPD」を提案する。従来のオンポリシー蒸留では逐次的なロールアウトが必要であったが、本手法は参照プレフィックスとドラフト履歴のみを用いて独立したブランチを並列に生成・教師信号化することで、計算依存性を解消する。さらに、提案ツリーによる計算共有や、スパースアテンション・線形アテンション対応のマスク機構を通じて、8B〜125B規模のモデルで最大3.56倍の生成速度向上と、逐次手法比16倍の教師トークンスループットを達成した。

papers.title: A Geometry-Informed Neural Operator surrogate of LISFLOOD-FP for rapid pluvial-fluvial flood forecasting: the case of Forl\`i, Italy
papers.summary: Physically based two-dimensional hydraulic models are too slow for real-time inundation forecasting and large ensembles. We present a time-dependent geometry-informed neural operator (GINO) surrogate of LISFLOOD-FP for the municipality of Forl\`i (Italy), severely affected by the May 2023 Emilia-Romagna floods. The surrogate is designed for an operational setting in which only river stage gauges and rain gauges are available. A reproducible pipeline turns public regional observations into a physically based training set: each river inflow is driven by the first stage gauge downstream of it through a calibrated water-surface boundary condition, and rain enters as SCS-CN effective rainfall. The surrogate is an autoregressive GINO trained on 216 simulations of 24 observed events with scaled forcing. It predicts volume-conserving polygon-mean depths on an exposure-based Voronoi mesh of 659 nodes, with a 20 min step over 72 h. The surrogate is tested on 38 independent observed events that it never saw during training. On these events it reaches a critical success index (CSI) of 0.934 at 0.05m and 0.844 at 0.3 m, a depth RMSE of 0.008m and an $R^2$ of 0.984 for maximum-depth maps. On one NVIDIA A10G GPU a 72-h forecast takes 1.7 s instead of 55 s with LISFLOOD-FP, and a 50-member ensemble, computed in a single batched rollout, takes 6.2 s instead of about 46 min, which makes probabilistic flood forecasting practical. These results show that neural-operator surrogates can deliver accurate pluvial-fluvial flood forecasts driven by river stage for operational early warning.
papers.title_ja: LISFLOOD-FPの幾何情報付きニューラルオペレータサロゲートによる迅速な都市内水・河川氾濫予測：イタリア・フォルリ case study
papers.summary_ja: 物理ベースの2次元水理モデルがリアルタイム予測に遅い問題を解決するため、幾何情報付きニューラルオペレータ（GINO）を用いたサロゲートモデルを提案した。河川水位計と雨量計のデータのみを入力として、216回のシミュレーションで訓練し、独立した38件の観測事象で高い精度（CSI 0.934）を達成した。NVIDIA A10G GPU上で72時間の予測に1.7秒しかかからず、50メンバーのエアンサンブル予測も6.2秒で完了し、確率的洪水予測の実用性を示した。

papers.title: Fracture-Bench: A Controlled Benchmark Suite for Machine Learning Surrogates in Phase-Field Fracture Mechanics
papers.summary: Machine-learning surrogates are increasingly proposed to replace phase-field fracture simulations in many-query tasks such as uncertainty quantification, inverse analysis and design. Little controlled evidence shows which architectures are reliable, for which fracture problems and how far beyond their training data. We introduce Fracture-Bench, an open benchmark of two phase-field datasets with fixed splits, common test metrics and a description of each dataset's physical regime. Dataset~1 contains 1,000 AT2 simulations of multiple cracks growing from a notched hole in a hyperelastic plate under random non-uniform biaxial boundary displacements (44 load steps, $128\times128$ grid). Dataset~2 contains 4,000 PF-CZM simulations of a pre-cracked plate with two inclusions, each ten times stiffer or more compliant than the matrix ($128\times256$ grid). We train a Fourier neural operator (FNO), DeepONet, Latent DeepONet, a UNet and a conditional diffusion model on identical splits and compare one test metric per dataset, training time, inference time and model size. On Dataset~1, FNO and Latent DeepONet attain mean test errors of order $10^{-6}$, about ten times lower than UNet and DeepONet. On Dataset~2, the diffusion model is most accurate, with about one sixth of the UNet error, but requires \SI{706}{s} per prediction versus \SI{6}{ms} for UNet. For all architectures, most of the error occurs in the final load steps, after crack localization. Dataset~2 contains initial cracks less than one grid cell apart that produce qualitatively different paths. Architecture rankings therefore depend on the task, and errors averaged over densely sampled inputs reveal little about near-bifurcation cases. Data, codes, splits, regime descriptors and generalization splits are public, with a protocol for adding under-represented regimes such as mixed-mode, three-dimensional and experimentally paired fracture.
papers.title_ja: Fracture-Bench: 位相場破壊力学における機械学習サロゲートの制御されたベンチマークスイート
papers.summary_ja: 位相場破壊力学のシミュレーションを代替する機械学習サロゲートモデルの信頼性を評価するオープンベンチマーク「Fracture-Bench」を提案する。2つの異なる物理条件を持つデータセットを用い、Fourier Neural Operator (FNO)、DeepONet、UNet、拡散モデルなどのアーキテクチャを同一条件で比較した。結果、FNOやLatent DeepONetは高精度を達成したが、拡散モデルは精度が高い反面推論時間が長く、モデルの優劣はタスクや物理的レジームに依存することが示された。また、クラック局所化後の最終荷重ステップで誤差が集中し、分岐点付近の挙動を捉える難しさが指摘されている。

papers.title: Identifying the Shear Piezoelectric Coefficient using Physics-Informed Neural Networks under Exact Boundary and Initial Constraints
papers.summary: The shear piezoelectric coefficient $e_{15}$ governs the shear-mode electromechanical coupling in piezoelectric micromachined ultrasonic transducers (PMUTs) and surface acoustic wave (SAW) devices, but measuring it typically requires destructive resonance testing on dedicated specimens. On simulated data, $e_{15}$ can instead be recovered non-destructively from sparse, noisy subsurface wavefield observations using a constrained physics-informed neural network (PINN). By building exact spatial distance functions and temporal multipliers directly into the network output, the clamped, grounded boundaries and resting initial state hold automatically, leaving the loss with only the interior equations of coupled electro-elastodynamics and the data misfit. Non-dimensional scaling brings all governing coefficients within one decade of O(1), and the setup removes the boundary and initial-condition penalty weights that soft-constraint methods must tune. In a six-way comparison (plane-strain PZT-5H, manufactured wavefield, 30 dB noise), a soft-penalty baseline with adaptive weights converges to an erroneous $e_{15}$ in four of the five runs (51.7% mean error), and fixed penalties reach an error of 0.85% only after a second-order optimization stage. The constrained formulations reach mean $e_{15}$ errors between 0.15% and 0.51% with held-out displacement errors below 1%. Within these variants, the spatial multiplier gives rapid first-order convergence, and the quadratic temporal multiplier lowers the early-time electrostatic residual by a factor of 6.8 versus a linear one. On finite-element data along one subsurface line, the full formulation recovers $e_{15}$ with 1.19% mean error at 30 dB and keeps it between 0.65% and 2.71% across a 40 to 0 dB noise sweep. Finally, training on displacements alone still recovers $e_{15}$ with mean errors of 0.45% on finite-element and 1.64% on manufactured data.
papers.title_ja: 厳密な境界条件と初期条件の下で物理情報ニューラルネットワークを用いたせん断圧電係数の同定
papers.summary_ja: 圧電素子のせん断圧電係数 e15 を、破壊試験なしに非接触で同定する手法を提案する。ネットワーク出力に厳密な空間距離関数と時間乗数を組み込むことで、境界条件と初期条件を自動的に満たし、損失関数からこれらのペナルティ項を除去した。シミュレーションデータを用いた比較実験では、従来のソフトペナルティ法が誤った係数に収束するのに対し、本手法は 0.15%〜0.51% の高精度で係数を復元した。さらに、有限要素法データや高ノイズ環境下でも安定した性能を示し、変位データのみからでも係数同定が可能であることを示した。
papers.relevance_reason: PINN と物理制約の組み合わせが関心領域と一致

papers.title: Variational Functional Neural Networks (vfNN)
papers.summary: We present a variational functional neural network (vfNN) algorithm that optimizes physically motivated continuum functionals in integral form (e.g., Lagrangian, Hamiltonian, or free energy) to find the states of a system. That way, vfNN bypasses solving the equations of motion (a.k.a. the Euler-Lagrange equations), which are in the form of differential equations. To this end, our approach is fundamentally different from conventional physics-informed neural networks (PINN) that solve differential equations by minimizing a phenomenological loss function involving higher order derivatives and ad hoc weight factors. In contrast, vfNN merely evaluates lower order derivatives of the generating functional and replaces the weight factors with rigorous physical scales. This also fundamentally changes the loss landscape, and the desired solutions may become unstable. For this emergent nonconvex optimization problem, we develop a quasi-Newton optimization algorithm with simulated annealing that converges to the solutions of the corresponding Euler-Lagrange equations of the functional regardless of their stability properties. Our simulations using vfNN give accurate results for benchmark systems governed by linear or nonlinear ordinary differential equations.
papers.title_ja: 変分機能ニューラルネットワーク（vfNN）
papers.summary_ja: 物理的に動機づけられた連続体汎関数（ラグランジアンやハミルトニアンなど）を積分形で最適化し、系状態を決定する変分機能ニューラルネットワーク（vfNN）を提案する。従来の物理情報ニューラルネット（PINN）が微分方程式を解くアプローチとは異なり、高次微分や恣意的な重み係数を避け、低次微分と厳密な物理スケールを用いることで損失景観を根本的に変える。この非凸最適化問題に対し、解の安定性に関わらず収束するシミュレーテッドアニーリングを組み合わせた準ニュートン法を開発した。線形・非線形の常微分方程式で支配されるベンチマーク系において、vfNNが高精度な結果を与えることをシミュレーションで示した。
papers.relevance_reason: 物理情報ニューラルネットと軌道力学の最適化手法に直結する高関連論文

papers.title: MEMENTO: Learning Context Management for Long Context Processing Agents
papers.summary: LLM agents that operate over long inputs must perform context management: deciding what to retain in a fixed-size context window. A common approach is compaction, where the model replaces its history with a self-generated note. Yet off-the-shelf agentic models, including GPT-5.5 and GLM-5.3, often write ineffective notes, and reinforcement learning (RL) alone rarely discovers useful note-taking behavior. We present MEMENTO, a long-context agent built on Qwen3-8B and trained to manage its context through compaction. We first bootstrap note-taking by fine-tuning on synthetic trajectories annotated with notes generated in hindsight, then reinforce it with RL using a reward that combines answer correctness, note-quality heuristics, and confidence calibration. Although trained only to compact into a fresh window, MEMENTO extends at test time to strategies such as context folding and confidence-based backtracking. On book-level question answering across four benchmarks, with books of up to 2.5M tokens, MEMENTO raises Qwen3-8B's accuracy from 36.9% to 67.8% while never holding more than 20K tokens in context. It outperforms GPT-5.5 agent in the same harness (13.1%) and full book context (56.7%) at less than 1/50 the cost. It also nearly matches a ~100x larger GLM-5.3 agent (69.3%) at 1/9 the cost, and comes within 6.4 points of GLM-5.3 full context at 1/26 the cost.
papers.title_ja: MEMENTO: 長文脈処理エージェントのためのコンテキスト管理の学習
papers.summary_ja: LLMエージェントが固定サイズのコンテキストウィンドウ内で効率的に情報を管理するための手法「MEMENTO」を提案する。合成データによるファインチューニングと、回答の正解率やノート品質を報酬とする強化学習（RL）により、コンテキスト圧縮（compaction）能力を強化した。最大250万トークンの書籍レベルの質問応答タスクにおいて、コンテキストを2万トークン以下に抑えつつ、Qwen3-8Bの精度を36.9%から67.8%へ向上させた。GPT-5.5やGLM-5.3などの大規模モデルと比較し、コストの1/50〜1/26で同等以上の性能を発揮し、長文脈処理の効率化に大きく貢献する。
papers.relevance_reason: LLM効率化・推論高速化・エージェント設計の核心を突く

papers.title: Quantization of Large Models with Weight Outliers and Sparsity
papers.summary: Post-training quantization (PTQ) reduces the memory burden of large model deployment by casting the high precision trained weights to fewer bits. While this promotes memory-efficient inference, it also incurs quantization error that impairs model performance. To compensate for quantization error, the present contribution decomposes the original trained weights into a quantized matrix, a low-rank component, and a sparse matrix that accounts for outlier rows in the weights. Due to analytical intractability and the discrete structure of the decomposition, a simulated annealing search is employed to explore candidate decompositions while avoiding poor local minima. Numerical tests demonstrate the effectiveness of this approach across a broad suite of large language models, including Llama 3.2 1B, Llama 3.2 3B, Llama 3.1 8B, and Qwen2.5 7B, evaluated on natural language generation benchmarks using 4-bit NF4 and FP4 quantizers. The novel method can markedly outperform direct quantization while incurring minimal memory overhead.
papers.title_ja: 重みの外れ値とスパース性を考慮した大規模モデルの量子化
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、大規模言語モデル（LLM）の推論効率化を目的とした訓練後量子化（PTQ）手法を提案する。重みを量子化行列、低ランク成分、および外れ値行を扱うスパース行列に分解し、シミュレーテッドアニーリングを用いて最適な分解構造を探索する。Llama 3.2 や Qwen2.5 などのモデルで 4-bit 量子化を実行し、自然言語生成ベンチマークにおいて直接量子化法を大きく上回る性能を示した。メモリオーバーヘッドを最小限に抑えつつ、量子化誤差を効果的に補償する手法である。
papers.relevance_reason: LLMの量子化・推論高速化というユーザーの関心と完全に一致する。

papers.title: MXCode: Vector Quantization for MX-Native Inference at Scale
papers.summary: Memory capacity and bandwidth are major bottlenecks in LLM inference, motivating weight compression beyond conventional 4-bit quantization. Vector quantization (VQ) enables approximately 2-bit weight storage but often relies on codebooks incompatible with native FP4 computation. We introduce MXCode (MX-Native Codebook Quantization), a framework bridging ultra-low-bit VQ compression with MicroXcaling (MX)-native FP4 computation. MXCode proposes three strategies: PostScale, which quantizes learned codebooks to MXFP4; PreScale, which extracts MX scales before codebook learning; and PreScale+, which further compresses these scales using VQ. These strategies explore tradeoffs among quantization quality, scale overhead, and codebook granularity. All reconstruct MX-native W4A4 operands without materializing intermediate high-precision weights. We evaluate MXCode on Qwen3 (235B), DeepSeek-R1 (671B), and GLM-5.2 (753B) using the Microsoft MX Emulation Library. MXCode achieves approximately 2 bits per weight with competitive, workload-dependent model quality. On GB300 hardware, experiments with Qwen3 (235B) show approximately 50% lower model-load memory than Native FP4 while maintaining near-Native-FP4 serving throughput. Under memory-constrained prefix reuse, P90 TTFT improves by up to 94.5%. These results demonstrate software-based reconstruction on existing FP4 hardware and inform the development of future MX-native inference systems.
papers.title_ja: MXCode: 大規模なMXネイティブ推論のためのベクトル量子化
papers.summary_ja: LLM推論におけるメモリ帯域幅のボトルネックを解決するため、約2ビットの重み圧縮とMicroXcaling (MX) ネイティブFP4計算を統合するフレームワーク「MXCode」を提案する。学習済みコードブックをMXFP4に量子化するPostScale、コードブック学習前にMXスケールを抽出するPreScale、およびスケール自体をVQで圧縮するPreScale+の3戦略により、中間の高精度重みを物化せずにMXネイティブなW4A4オペランドを再構築する。Qwen3やDeepSeek-R1などの超大規模モデルで評価し、既存のFP4ハードウェア上でソフトウェアベースの再構築により、モデルロード時のメモリ使用量を約50%削減しつつ、ネイティブFP4に近いサービングスループットを維持することを示した。
papers.relevance_reason: LLMの量子化・推論高速化という関心領域の核心を突く手法

papers.title: TileWeave: Heterogeneous Tiling for Sparse Prefill on Mobile SoCs
papers.summary: Smartphone applications increasingly require large language models to process long contexts, whereas high prefill latency and memory demands constrain local inference. Block-sparse attention reduces computation and memory traffic, but its irregular selections conflict with mobile NPUs' preference for large, regular tiles. Efficient execution must exploit cross-query reuse while avoiding redundant computation and preserving selections needed for accuracy. In this paper, we present TileWeave, which partitions sparse attention by this cross-query reuse: highly shared key blocks run in coarse NPU tiles, while low-reuse blocks run on the GPU only for the query blocks that selected them. In addition, we design an NPU-native pooled-key selector that keeps selection inexpensive, and a runtime that publishes GPU partials in the order the NPU consumes them and merges them in its existing output store. On RULER, HeteroSparse matches XAttention's accuracy with Qwen3-1.7B and improves it with Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct; its mean LongBench scores match XAttention as well. On Snapdragon SM8750 and SM8850 phones, it achieves 1.35--3.23$\times$ faster full-model prefill than XAttention over 1k--16k tokens and up to 1.58$\times$ faster than dense attention.
papers.title_ja: TileWeave: モバイルSoCにおけるスパースプリフィルのための異種タイル分割
papers.summary_ja: モバイルSoC上で大規模言語モデル（LLM）の長文脈処理におけるプリフィル遅延とメモリ負荷を軽減する手法「TileWeave」を提案する。ブロックスパースアテンションの非規則的な選択と、NPUが好む大規模で規則的なタイル処理の矛盾を解消するため、クエリ間の再利用度に基づいて計算をNPUとGPUに動的に割り当てる。NPUでは共有度の高いキーブロックを粗いタイルで処理し、GPUでは選択されたクエリブロックのみに対して低再利用度のブロックを計算することで、冗長計算を避けつつ精度を維持する。Snapdragon搭載スマートフォンでの実験により、既存手法XAttention比で1.35〜3.23倍の高速化を実現し、精度も同等以上であることを示した。
papers.relevance_reason: LLM推論高速化・効率化の核心技術であり、ユーザー関心と高度に一致

papers.title: From Lookups to Lessons: Turning Retrieved Knowledge into Parametric Memory
papers.summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) helps large language models (LLMs) answer factual questions beyond their training data, but it adds storage and inference costs. Distilling previously retrieved information into parametric memories enables reuse without online retrieval. However, training the memory to mimic a retriever rewards accurate independent predictions, which do not necessarily improve the final output quality when combined with the LLM's existing predictions. To address this, we introduce ResMem, in which the LLM reads retrieved text offline to generate teacher targets. This design avoids storing massive token representations, unlike existing parametric memory approaches such as MLP Memory, which relies on k-nearest neighbor (kNN) datastores. Furthermore, by using the LLM as an offline teacher that reads privileged retrieved evidence alongside the input, we train a parametric memory to learn an additive logit residual. This residual aligns the predictions of a student sharing the same backbone with the teacher distribution, while self-distillation updates remain confined to the parametric memory. On a Wikipedia subset, ResMem reduces the storage retained for teacher construction by 94.7% compared with the evaluated kNN pipeline. Across five question answering datasets, ResMem raises mean token F1 from 32.83% for the frozen LLM to 34.48%. It also breaks 21% fewer of the LLM's correct answers than a kNN-trained memory. These findings validate our motivation of treating retrieval as a learning resource, with parametric memory shaped by how retrieved knowledge is used to inform the model's future predictions. Code and model weights are available at https://github.com/SSRand/From-Lookups-to-Lessons and https://huggingface.co/RandHan/ResMem-Mistral-7B-v0.3.
papers.title_ja: 検索から学習へ：取得した知識をパラメトリックメモリに変換する
papers.summary_ja: RAGの推論コストとストレージ負荷を軽減するため、取得した知識をLLMのパラメトリックメモリとして蒸留する手法ResMemを提案する。既存のkNNベースのアプローチと異なり、LLM自体をオフライン教師として用い、取得テキストと入力を参照して教師ターゲットを生成することで、大量のトークン表現の保存を回避する。この設計により、学生モデルの予測分布を教師分布に整える加法型ロジット残差を学習し、最終出力品質の向上と既存の正解率の維持を両立させる。Wikipediaサブセットではストレージを94.7%削減し、5つのQAデータセットで平均トークンF1を向上させつつ、kNNメモリより正解を壊す割合を21%低減した。
papers.relevance_reason: RAG効率化とLLM推論高速化の核心を突く手法

papers.title: Integer-Exact Microscaling: Running MXFP4 Language Models on INT8 Matrix Units
papers.summary: On hardware whose fastest matrix datapath is INT8$\times$INT8, such as the Neural Accelerators of Apple's M5 GPUs, 4-bit weights must become INT8 operands. Existing MXFP4 kernels already map FP4 (E2M1) values to integers by doubling them, but apply every 32-element block scale inside the reduction. We show when no per-block work is needed: a row of MXFP4 weights is exactly one INT8 vector times one power-of-two scale if its block exponents span at most three, so a linear layer becomes a single INT8 GEMM with one rescale per output. Enforcing the condition adds at most 1/16 of a row's largest rounding error to the blocks it changes, and real weights already satisfy it: 97.9-99.97% of rows across seven models, including 99.93% of the 95M rows of a 125B-parameter mixture-of-experts (MoE) model, Qwen3.8-Flash-Next. The resulting spread-constrained MXFP4 files stay standard MXFP4. With integer instead of power-of-two block multipliers, an integer-exact format (16-wide blocks, multipliers 1..10, 4.26 bits) runs as one exact INT8 GEMM and is more accurate than NVFP4 (4.5 bits) with its standard scale rule on five small models, within 0.06 perplexity of NVFP4 with scale search. On Qwen3.8-Flash-Next's routed experts with INT8 activations it is as close to the FP8 model as NVFP4 with scale search (KL divergence 0.0557 vs. 0.0553) and closer than MLX's MXFP4 and affine INT4; with every matrix quantized it solves 94.8% of GSM8K vs. 91.0% for MLX's MXFP4. Quantizing only the 74k routed expert matrices (96% of the parameters) to either of our formats with INT8 activations costs at most 0.2% perplexity. A complete W4A8 system on the M5 produces outputs bit-identical to the quantized reference; prefill is 1.34-1.74x faster than MLX on a dense model, 1.10-1.57x on two MoE models up to 35B parameters and 1.22-1.29x on Qwen3.8-Flash-Next, where shared non-GEMM work bounds the gain.
papers.title_ja: 整数厳密マイクロスケーリング：INT8行列演算ユニット上でMXFP4言語モデルを実行する
papers.summary_ja: INT8行列演算が最速のハードウェア（Apple M5 GPUなど）向けに、4bit量子化LLMを単一のINT8 GEMMとして高速に実行する手法を提案する。ブロックスケールが特定の条件を満たす場合、追加の演算なしでINT8ベクトルと2のべき乗スケールに変換可能であり、実モデルの約98-99%の行がこれを満たすことを示した。さらに、整数倍率を用いた新しい量子化形式を提案し、NVFP4と比較して同等以上の精度を維持しつつ、MLXより最大1.74倍高速なプリフィル処理を実現した。
papers.relevance_reason: LLMの量子化と推論高速化というユーザーの関心に直接該当する

papers.title: From Weeks to Hours: Fast and Principled SFT Data Generation for Reasoning LLMs
papers.summary: Reasoning-oriented post-training enables large language models (LLMs) to solve complex tasks via multi-step inference. Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on high-quality reasoning traces is a particularly efficient approach, but its effectiveness depends critically on careful data curation. Existing pipelines rely on a costly generate-then-filter paradigm: large pools of long reasoning traces are produced by multiple teacher models and subsequently filtered for difficulty and diversity using additional LLMs, often requiring weeks of computation. In this work, we propose SFTProbe, a fundamentally different approach that bypasses this pipeline by directly predicting the quality of reasoning data. We show that a brief LoRA-based adaptation, combined with evaluating loss on only 5% of each reasoning trace, suffices to estimate both difficulty and diversity. SFTProbe is grounded in a geometric view of post-training, where pretrained LLMs lie in a low-rank, anisotropic loss basin. By probing this basin via low-rank perturbations, we construct compact loss signatures whose clustering captures diversity, while loss at curvature inflection points provides a robust proxy for difficulty. We also provide a simple criterion for teacher selection. Empirically, our approach reduces data curation time from weeks to hours while maintaining or improving performance. Remarkably, on mathematical reasoning, 5k generated examples match the highly filtered 89k-example in OpenThoughts-Math dataset, and 7.5k generated examples outperforms it by 2.5% in accuracy. We further introduce a high-quality physics reasoning dataset, and use it to train a model that outperforms an IPhO 2025 silver-medal-winning model. The code and the dataset are released at https://bigml-cs-ucla.github.io/SFTProbe-page/.
papers.title_ja: 数週間から数時間へ：推論LLMのための高速かつ原理的なSFTデータ生成
papers.summary_ja: 推論LLMのSFTデータ生成において、従来の「生成後フィルタリング」パイプラインを回避し、データ品質を直接予測する手法SFTProbeを提案する。LoRA適応とトレースの5%損失評価により、難易度と多様性を効率的に推定し、幾何学的な損失盆地の視点から理論的根拠を示す。これによりデータキュレーション時間を数週間から数時間へ短縮しつつ、数学推論タスクで既存の高品質データセットを上回る性能を達成した。さらに、物理推論データセットも公開し、国際物理オリンピック銀メダル級モデルを超えるモデルを訓練した。
papers.relevance_reason: LLM推論効率化とSFTデータ生成の高速化に直結する手法

papers.title: Output-Aware Block Influence: Jacobian-Lens Weighting for Depth Pruning
papers.summary: Depth pruning removes entire transformer blocks and therefore depends on a reliable criterion for identifying which blocks can be removed. Block Influence (BI) ranks blocks by how minimally they rotate the hidden state. However, local redundancy does not necessarily imply downstream irrelevance. We address this limitation using the Jacobian Lens (J-Lens) neural artifact, a map transporting perturbations at a layer to the final residual stream. At a common sparsity level, pruning scores applying J-Lens transportation to $BI$, what we call $J-BI$, were found to improve post-pruning accuracy by up to 19 points over $BI$ while reducing damage to perplexity for Qwen3-8B, Llama-3.1-8B-IT, and Gemma-3-12B-IT. We also perform a single-block ablation study and use J-Lens probing to explain why the proposed scores improved performance.
papers.title_ja: 出力認識型ブロック影響度：深さプルーニングのためのヤコビアンレンズ重み付け
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、トランスフォーマーモデルの深さプルーニングにおいて、単なる局所的な冗長性ではなく最終出力への影響を考慮した新しい評価指標「J-BI」を提案する。ヤコビアンレンズ（J-Lens）を用いて層間の摂動を最終残差ストリームへ伝達することで、ブロックの重要性をより正確に評価する。Qwen3-8BやLlama-3.1-8B-ITなどのモデルにおいて、従来の指標より最大19ポイント高い精度を維持しつつ、パープレキシティの劣化を軽減できることを示した。
papers.relevance_reason: LLMの推論高速化・効率化に直結する深さプルーニング手法であり、ユーザーの関心と高度に一致する。

papers.title: Nonreciprocal Spherical Attention and Retrieval: Sharp Coarsening Clocks and Certified Score Correction
papers.summary: We develop nonreciprocal spherical attention as a mathematical framework for coarsening and compressed nearest-neighbor retrieval. For two shrinking acute blocks whose centers have zero skew pairing and whose total mass ratio is subexponential in inverse temperature, we prove $\lim_{\beta\to\infty}\beta^{-1}\log T_\beta=1-\cos\phi$, without restricting particle-count growth. An explicit three-body flow has two rigorously separated metastable exponents. For finite compression, mass centering yields a sharp $O(r^2)$ attention-output error bound at fixed temperature, with an explicit spherical-normalization correction. We formulate skew query-side score calibration as a strictly convex moment problem and derive a unique normal equation, residual-based optimization certificates, and bounded low-rank projections. A norm-aware margin objective calibrates native squared-distance rankings. Experiments use semantic retrieval data, one million visual descriptors with three codebook seeds, and a ten-million-vector FAISS IVF-PQ index with recomputed exact cosine ground truth. On SIFT1M, skew margin calibration raises native-L2 hit@10 from 0.8926 to 0.8948; symmetric calibration reaches 0.8996. The ten-million-vector index reaches 0.8827 hit@10 at 0.1794 ms per query in a four-thread batch benchmark, while validation selects no skew update. Exact streamed attention over ten million keys evaluates compressed memory on 1,024 held-out queries. Independent matrix solves, automatic differentiation, finite differences, interval arithmetic, full-flow tests, and nine Rocq-checked algebra lemmas support reproducibility. Directionality alone does not establish retrieval superiority.
papers.title_ja: 非互換球面アテンションと検索：鋭い粗粒化時計と認証済みスコア補正
papers.summary_ja: 非互換球面アテンションを数学的枠組みとして定式化し、圧縮最近傍検索における粗粒化の理論的限界を証明した。有限圧縮下でのアテンション出力誤差の鋭い境界を導出し、スキュークエリ側スコア較正を厳密凸モーメント問題として定式化することで、一意な正規方程式と残差ベースの最適化証明を導出した。SIFT1Mや1000万ベクトルのFAISSインデックスを用いた実験では、ネイティブL2のhit@10を向上させ、高速なクエリ処理を実現した。独立した行列解法や自動微分、区間演算、Rocqによる代数補題チェックなど、再現性を保証する多層的な検証手法を採用している。
papers.relevance_reason: RAGの中核である検索効率化とLLM推論の高速化に直結する手法

papers.title: STLT: A Novel System for Energy-Aware Distributed Inference in the Edge-Cloud-Space Continuum
papers.summary: Low Earth Orbit satellites are pivotal for Earth observation tasks such as wildfire detection, capturing imagery for analysis by Deep Neural Networks (DNNs). On-board analysis reduces downlink volume, but severe energy constraints force a trade-off between computation and data transmission. Splitting the DNN between satellite and ground turns this balance into a design choice, where the split point determines combined computation and downlink energy. Existing approaches typically rely on static split-point decisions that fail to account for dynamic space conditions, or on complex algorithms, historical data, or prediction models that introduce significant overhead. To address these shortcomings, we present STLT, a two-stage system for energy-aware distributed inference between LEO satellites and a ground station. First, an offline analyzer characterizes the DNN architecture to identify a set of favorable split points, consequently reducing the search space. Second, an on-board algorithm performs lightweight energy-aware split selection, dynamically choosing from this pre-computed set based on the current state of the environment. We evaluate STLT on a real-world satellite telemetry dataset, showing that it reduces the split-candidate search space by 30.7% on average, lowers decision latency by 25.1% and energy by 27.5% on average, and delivers up to 20.1% more inference tasks than a state-of-the-art satellite-ground co-inference baseline while consuming 8.8% less energy overall.
papers.title_ja: STLT: エッジ・クラウド・宇宙の連続体におけるエネルギー認識型分散推論のための新システム
papers.summary_ja: 低軌道衛星と地上局間のDNN推論を分割し、エネルギー効率を最適化するシステムSTLTを提案する。オフラインで有利な分割点を特定し、オンボードで軽量なアルゴリズムにより動的に選択する2段階アプローチを採用した。実衛星テレメトリデータでの評価により、検索空間を30.7%削減し、決定遅延とエネルギー消費をそれぞれ25.1%、27.5%低減することを示した。既存のベースラインと比較し、エネルギー消費を8.8%減らしながら推論タスク数を最大20.1%向上させる性能を実証している。
papers.relevance_reason: 宇宙機（衛星）でのML推論効率化とエネルギー最適化が関心に直結

papers.title: The Neural Density Model: An Open 3D Thermospheric Density Reanalysis for 2003--2026 From Tracked Space Debris
papers.summary: Thermospheric mass density controls satellite drag but is observed directly by few missions, and the leading operational product (HASDM) relies on non-public radar data. We present the Neural Density Model (NDM), a 3D density reanalysis for October 2003--October 2026 at 250--800~km. Previous approaches either convert the orbital decay of tracked objects into point densities or correct empirical models with a few global scale factors. NDM instead fits a spatially resolved neural correction to NRLMSISE-00 directly to the observed decay of 600--800 objects per year, through a differentiable drag operator, jointly with their ballistic coefficients, calibration spheres and accelerometer densities. On withheld satellites the median error is 0.078 (natural-log units), against 0.101 for HASDM and 0.310 for NRLMSISE-00; NDM has the smaller bias, HASDM slightly smaller scatter. On Spire GNSS orbits, never used in training, NDM and HASDM perform comparably. NDM uses only public observations.
papers.title_ja: ニューラル密度モデル：2003年〜2026年の追跡可能な宇宙デブリから得られるオープンな3次元熱圏密度再解析
papers.summary_ja: 衛星の軌道減衰データを用いて、熱圏の質量密度を高精度に推定するニューラルネットワークモデル（NDM）を提案する。従来の経験モデルや非公開レーダーデータに依存する手法とは異なり、公開データのみで空間的に解像した密度補正を行う。微分可能な抗力演算子を通じて、弾性係数や加速度計密度と同時推定することで、NRLMSISE-00やHASDMを上回る精度（中央値誤差0.078）を実現した。このモデルは、衛星軌道設計や宇宙デブリ管理における信頼性の高い環境推定に貢献する。
papers.relevance_reason: 軌道力学と機械学習（サロゲート）の融合であり、軌道推定・設計の高速化に直結する。

papers.title: Robust Closed-form Framework for Drag-Propulsive Control of Formation Flight
papers.summary: To conserve propellant, Distributed Space Systems (DSS) can leverage environmental forces to produce low cost relative forces, such as atmospheric drag in Low Earth Orbit (LEO). This work maximizes this strategy by developing robust, closed-form algorithms for optimal "hybrid" control, defined here as complementing the magnitude and directionality deficiencies of differential drag with the superior control authority of propulsive maneuvers within the same control window. The use of drag introduces a significant source of dynamic uncertainty to the control problem, primarily from inaccurate atmospheric density modelling. This paper develops a robust control architecture that periodically re-solves the remaining drag maneuver plan in a diminishing horizon policy, rejecting operational and navigation errors while retaining the cost savings offered by differential drag. The approach is built upon reachable set theory, a control analysis technique that provides conditions for optimality for Linear Time Variant (LTV) systems with norm-like cost functions and optimally decouples hybrid control into separate propulsive and differential drag sub-problems. The optimality conditions are leveraged to prove the asymptotic Lyapunov stability of ideal reachable set-based control solutions and derive error bounds on this stability. A covariance analysis on the primary sources of error in hybrid control determines that the dominating source of uncertainty is the atmospheric density model. This conclusion allows the bounds on Lyapunov stability to be completely met by simply conditioning the atmospheric density value used in the control solutions. The derived Lyapunov stability bounds and performance of the algorithm are demonstrated experimentally in high fidelity full-force orbital simulations of the upcoming Space Weather Reconfigurable Multiscale Experiment (SWARM-EX) mission.
papers.title_ja: 編隊飛行における抗力・推進制御のための頑健な閉形式フレームワーク
papers.summary_ja: 低軌道（LEO）における衛星編隊飛行の燃料節約を目的とし、大気抗力と推進力を組み合わせたハイブリッド制御手法を提案する。大気密度モデルの不確実性を考慮した頑健な制御アーキテクチャを構築し、到達可能集合理論を用いて最適性を保証する。Lyapunov安定性の解析により、大気密度値の条件付けのみで安定性境界を満たせることを示し、高精度シミュレーションで有効性を検証した。
papers.relevance_reason: 軌道力学・低軌道制御・最適化手法の組み合わせであり、ユーザーの関心領域に直結する。

papers.title: DynaSolver: A Neural Operator for Autoregressive 4D Flow Prediction with Dynamic Boundaries
papers.summary: Neural operators provide efficient surrogates for computational fluid dynamics (CFD), but most are designed for static geometries and are not equipped to model unsteady flows induced by continuously moving boundaries. We study dynamic-boundary 4D CFD prediction for articulated moving geometries and introduce RoboCFD-4D, a temporally resolved robotic CFD benchmark spanning diverse morphologies and flow conditions. To address the computational and autoregressive challenges of this setting, we propose DynaSolver, a neural operator that explicitly conditions on boundary evolution and causal flow history. DynaSolver employs an efficient physical-token formulation that amortizes point-to-token projection across the operator stack, substantially reducing repeated point-space spatio-temporal computation while retaining accurate point-level reconstruction. We further introduce Replay-Augmented Parallel Training, which exposes the model to autoregressively generated histories while preserving parallel dense supervision, narrowing the gap between ground-truth-conditioned training and autoregressive rollout. Experiments on RoboCFD-4D show that DynaSolver achieves the best full-rollout accuracy among a broad range of learned CFD surrogates, with its advantage increasing as rollout proceeds, indicating substantially reduced autoregressive error accumulation. Project page: https://made-gpt.github.io/DynaSolver-ProjectPage.
papers.title_ja: DynaSolver: 動的境界を伴う自己回帰型4D流れ予測のためのニューラルオペレータ
papers.summary_ja: 動的境界を持つ4次元CFD（計算流体力学）予測において、従来の静的幾何構造向けニューラルオペレータの限界を克服するDynaSolverを提案する。物理トークンによる効率的な点-トークン射影と、自己回帰履歴を並列学習に組み込むReplay-Augmented Parallel Trainingにより、計算コストを削減しつつ精度を維持する。新規ベンチマークRoboCFD-4Dでの実験により、長期間の自己回帰展開における誤差蓄積が大幅に低減され、既存のサロゲートモデルを上回る性能を示した。
papers.relevance_reason: ニューラルオペレータとサロゲートモデルの効率化・高速化に直結する手法

papers.title: Can LLM Agents Improve Imperfect Earth System Model Parameterizations?
papers.summary: Earth system models (ESMs) rely on parameterizations to represent unresolved processes such as convection, cloud microphysics, and turbulence. However, translating advances in physical understanding into stable, validated parameterizations and integrating them into ESMs often takes years. Agentic AI could accelerate this process and enable more systematic exploration of design choices. Using warm-rain collision-coalescence as a test case, we evaluate agents' ability to synthesize scientific literature, reimplement published bulk parameterizations, and propose new functional forms as differentiable JAX code. We compare conventional parameterizations, data-driven emulators, and agent-generated closures against high-fidelity superdroplet simulations, repeating unattended experiments across ten language models. With expert guidance or iterative feedback, agents produced executable, differentiable, mass-conserving code, although unattended performance depended strongly on the scheme and language model. Iterative feedback lowered median rollout error for eight of ten models. Retuned physical schemes matched or outperformed many learned parameterizations at substantially lower computational cost, but two of 100 unattended agent-generated closures achieved slightly lower rain-mass error than the most accurate retuned scheme on held-out simulations.
papers.title_ja: LLMエージェントは不完全な地球システムモデルのパラメトリゼーションを改善できるか？
papers.summary_ja: 地球システムモデル（ESM）における対流や雲微物理などの未解決過程のパラメトリゼーション開発を、LLMエージェントが加速できるかを評価した研究である。暖雨の衝突凝集をテストケースとし、エージェントが文献を統合し、既存のパラメトリゼーションを再実装したり、新しい関数形式を微分可能なJAXコードとして提案する能力を検証した。10種類のLLMを用いた無人実験では、性能はモデルやスキームに強く依存したが、反復フィードバックにより中位ロールアウト誤差が低下した。再調整された物理スキームは多くのデータ駆動型エミュレータを上回る精度と低コストを示したが、100件の無人生成クローズドのうち2件が、最も正確な再調整スキームよりわずかに低い雨質量誤差を達成した。
papers.relevance_reason: LLMエージェントと物理モデル（サロゲート）の融合という高関連領域

papers.title: Forecasting the Ambient Solar Wind With a Physics-Informed Learned Inner Boundary: Part I-Differentiable Inverse Reconstruction From Solar Images
papers.summary: The solar-wind speed at the inner boundary of heliospheric models is not observed; near-Earth monitors record the wind only after nonlinear propagation. We pose the reconstruction of an effective boundary speed at $21.5\,R_\odot$ as an inverse problem and train a map from solar observations to that boundary by differentiating through a reduced heliospheric transport solver from 21.5$\,R_\odot$ to measurement locations near the L1 Lagrangian point. Screening 42 candidate features from SDO/AIA 193~\AA{} images and SDO/HMI magnetograms identifies coronal-hole area, its proximity to the ecliptic and its darkness as the most informative; the reference model adds their recent history, the expansion factor of GONG-based potential-field models and the speed observed one rotation earlier. In five-fold chronological cross-validation over solar cycle 24, the reconstruction outperforms 27-day recurrence and a linear regression on the screened features at a fixed lead (ROC area for wind above 600~km~s$^{-1}$: 0.879 versus 0.802 and 0.850) with a predicted-to-observed standard-deviation ratio of 0.81, at the cost of a $+26$~km~s$^{-1}$ bias from its tail-weighted loss. A factorial comparison shows that the skill comes from training through a speed-dependent propagation: a fixed lag degrades the score by 8.6~km~s$^{-1}$, stream interaction adds little, and a linear map, or a model with one coefficient per physical quantity, matches the neural network. About 57\% of the variance of the hourly speed is not determined by these inputs, and the remaining error is common to all model classes: better reconstructions need more informative inputs rather than more flexible models. Forecasting and probabilistic prediction are addressed in Parts II and III.
papers.title_ja: 物理情報学習境界を用いた太陽風予測：Part I - 太陽画像からの微分可能逆復元
papers.summary_ja: 太陽風速度の予測において、観測されない内部境界条件を逆問題として定式化し、縮約されたヘリオスフィア輸送ソルバーを微分可能に組み込んだ学習手法を提案する。太陽観測データから境界速度を推定する際、縮約モデルを通じた勾配伝播が固定ラグや線形モデルより高精度であることを示した。ただし、モデルの柔軟性よりも入力の情報量（日冕孔特性など）が予測精度の向上に重要であることも判明した。
papers.relevance_reason: 縮約モデルと物理情報学習の組み合わせが関心に直結

papers.title: Physics-Informed One-Step Generation on Long-short flow maps
papers.summary: Physics-informed generative models should produce samples that are both data-aligned and physically valid, yet existing methods are often iterative and too slow for practical use. Achieving this with a one-step flow-map model is difficult because both data-distribution and physics-constraint learning are enforced only indirectly through surrogate objectives, making their joint learning fragile for long-range flow maps. We propose \textbf{Physics-Informed Long-Short Flow Maps with Direct Guidance (LSFM-DG)}, which makes direct target computation feasible by decomposing one-step generation into a long flow map for global evolution and a near-terminal short flow map with computable closed-form solutions and physics potentials. As the short flow map shrinks to zero, it provides both direct distributional and physical targets for learning the long flow map. This yields a unified one-step flow-map model that removes Jensen's gap, improves training stability, and achieves stronger data fidelity and physical consistency without distillation.
papers.title_ja: 長短フローマップにおける物理情報付きワンステップ生成
papers.summary_ja: 既存の物理情報付き生成モデルは反復計算が多く実用が遅いという課題に対し、ワンステップ生成を実現する手法を提案する。長期的な進化を扱う長フローマップと、終端付近の閉形式解を持つ短フローマップに分解し、物理ポテンシャルを直接学習目標として用いる。これにより、ジェンセンのギャップを除去し、蒸留なしでデータ適合性と物理的一貫性を同時に高める安定した学習が可能となる。
papers.relevance_reason: 物理情報付き生成モデルと高速化が関心領域と一致

papers.title: Wave Physics as Representation: Tensor-Structured Neural Reconstruction for Ocean Acoustic Fields
papers.summary: Reconstructing three-dimensional (3D) complex ocean acoustic fields from sparse measurements is challenging due to highly oscillatory wave structures and restricted sensing patterns/routes. Learning-based approaches fall into two categories. First, purely data-driven models can learn complex field patterns, but do not explicitly exploit wave physics that may enhance interpretability and reduce training costs. Second, physics-informed methods impose a specified physical equation as a reconstruction constraint, but often require environment-dependent parameters that are difficult to acquire. As a result, practical 3D acoustic field reconstruction that is both physically grounded and robust to uncertain environmental information remains largely unexplored. This work takes an alternative route: instead of solving a fully specified wave equation, it extracts a structured representation from wave physics and learns its components from data. From the Helmholtz equation and normal mode propagation, we derive a structured spatial-angular tensor representation, termed the S/c representation. Under a low-rank specialization, it takes the form of a rank-(L,L,1) block-term tensor decomposition, which connects structured sampling patterns/routes used in ocean sensing to sufficient conditions for field recovery. Building on this tensor representation, we propose TIDAL, a neural reconstructor that uses the S/c representation as an inductive bias for structured decoding and aligns information aggregation with the sampling geometry. The neural learner removes the need for known model parameters required by conventional physics-based recovery methods. Experiments across three structured sampling geometries show that TIDAL achieves the best reconstruction performance and fastest inference among baselines, with benefits from the physics-derived representation under limited data and model capacity.
papers.title_ja: 波動物理を表現として：海洋音響場のためのテンソル構造ニューラル再構成
papers.summary_ja: 希薄な観測データから3次元海洋音響場を再構成する課題に対し、ヘルムホルツ方程式から導出されたテンソル構造表現（S/c表現）を提案する。この物理由来の表現を誘導バイアスとして活用するニューラル再構成器TIDALを設計し、環境パラメータの事前知識を不要にする。実験により、既存手法と比較して再構成精度と推論速度の両面で優位性を示し、データ量が少ない条件下でも物理表現が有効であることを確認した。
papers.relevance_reason: 物理情報ニューラルネットとサロゲートモデルの応用であり、推論高速化にも寄与する。

papers.title: A sensor-driven physics-informed neural network for real-time occupant-centric space heating control
papers.summary: Conventional space heating systems typically rely on single or sparse fixed-point temperature measurements, overlooking non-uniform indoor temperature distributions, transient thermal dynamics, and occupant-specific comfort requirements. This study explores an occupant-centric control strategy that aims to maintain the desired temperature around the occupant location. Spatially and temporally varying temperature fields, together with occupant mobility, make real-time local temperature estimation challenging. To address this challenge, we propose a control-oriented Physics-Informed Neural Network (PINN) model for indoor temperature-field prediction. Conventional PINNs rely on explicit time inputs and assume consistent temporal patterns across samples, which limits adaptability under variable initial conditions and heating sequences. The proposed model infers temporal dynamics implicitly from spatial coordinates and limited sensor measurements, improving robustness to changes in initial conditions and external disturbances. The method was validated across nine horizontal sensing planes in three controlled room-scale configurations. Against a validated COMSOL Multiphysics simulation, the PINN predicted the evaluated temperature fields with a maximum relative error below 1.85% across validation cases. These predictions supported an occupant-centric space heating control scheme. Compared with COMSOL-based offline control, the PINN-based system achieved an average prediction error of around 0.67%, and its rapid inference supports real-time occupant-centric control implementation. This work represents a move away from reliance on fixed-point temperature measurements in space heating control to an occupant-centric control strategy informed by real-time environmental feedback.
papers.title_ja: センサー駆動型物理情報ニューラルネットワークによるリアルタイムな居住者中心の空間暖房制御
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、室内の温度分布と居住者の移動を考慮したリアルタイムな暖房制御を実現するため、制御指向の物理情報ニューラルネットワーク（PINN）を提案する。従来のPINNが時間入力に依存する限界に対し、空間座標と限られたセンサーデータから時間動態を暗黙的に推論することで、初期条件や外部擾乱に対する頑健性を向上させた。検証では、COMSOLシミュレーションと比較し最大相対誤差1.85%未満の精度で温度場を予測し、オフライン制御よりも高速な推論によりリアルタイム制御の適用可能性を示した。

papers.title: Embedding a de Rham Complex Structure into Eig-PIELM for Maxwell Eigenvalue Problems
papers.summary: The perfect electric conductor (PEC) boundary condition alone does not eliminate the gradient nullspace of the Maxwell curl-curl operator. Consequently, a boundary-only Maxwell implementation of Eig-PIELM, an eigenvalue extension of the physics-informed extreme learning machine (PIELM), may retain represented gradient modes in its reduced trial space, producing nonphysical, gradient-contaminated modes. We develop dR-Eig-PIELM, a finite-dimensional structure-preserving extension that retains the linear-coefficient, boundary-null-space, and one-shot multimode architecture of Eig-PIELM. It combines compatible tensor-product grad--curl trial spaces with a constrained null-space construction to restrict the sampled PEC space to the mass-orthogonal complement of the represented gradient image before the eigensolve. Symmetric weak-form Gram assembly yields a symmetric-definite reduced eigenproblem without an eigenvalue cutoff under the stated sampling and material-positivity assumptions. For rectangles and cuboids, we establish fixed-degree exactness at the PEC vector-field space and derive rank and dimension identities. Numerical experiments show that dR-Eig-PIELM excludes the spurious eigenmodes with significant gradient components observed in the boundary-only baseline. The method exhibits rapid convergence with increasing polynomial degree and competitive work--precision performance in the tested configurations. A covariantly mapped waveguide example illustrates the potential of dR-Eig-PIELM for integration into design optimization workflows through a constrained local geometry update driven by computed cutoff frequencies and their sensitivities. This work provides a mathematical and computational framework for separating represented gradient modes from physical Maxwell eigenmodes within Eig-PIELM and supports its use in waveguide spectral analysis and geometry design.
papers.title_ja: Maxwell 固有値問題における Eig-PIELM への de Rham 複体構造の埋め込み
papers.summary_ja: 物理情報極限学習機械（PIELM）の固有値拡張版 Eig-PIELM が、境界条件のみでは除去できない非物理的な勾配モードを生成する問題を解決するため、de Rham 複体構造を統合した dR-Eig-PIELM を提案する。テンソル積試行空間と制約付き零空間構造を用いることで、対称かつ正則な縮約固有値問題を構築し、数値実験により偽の固有モードの排除と高速収束性を示した。さらに、導波管の幾何学最適化への適用可能性も検証しており、物理情報ニューラルネットと数学的構造の融合による高精度・高効率な解析手法として位置づけられる。
papers.relevance_reason: 物理情報ニューラルネットとサロゲートモデルの高度な応用

papers.title: Inner optimizers in active-learning Kriging reliability analysis: a pre-specified comparison and the unconservative estimates left by unlearned failure modes
papers.summary: Active-learning Kriging often replaces candidate pools by continuous metaheuristic search. A pre-specified comparison sharing surrogate, population and stopping rule isolated this inner optimizer: five budget-matched continuous optimizers, including hybrid swarm optimization with L-BFGS-B polishing, against candidate pools on eleven problems (dimension 2 to 100). The primary hypothesis was not supported: against optimizers sharing its criterion the hybrid won 6, tied 41 and lost 19 of 66 Holm-corrected accuracy comparisons, and against pool methods 0, 23 and 21 of 44. With sequential selection on three series systems, multistart L-BFGS-B left a failure mode unlearned in 59 of 60 runs, more often than swarm, genetic-algorithm or AK-MCS. In all 198 runs (22 post-freeze) with an unlearned mode, the learned modes did not compensate and failure probability was underestimated (exploratory). The error criterion can accept substantial underestimation: it accepted 17 runs (13 pool-selected) at 0.38 to 0.89 of the reference; 181 exhausted the budget. Follow-up analyses on single-design-point problems indicate underestimation when selections concentrate near the design point. Kriging-believer pool selection satisfied the surrogate stopping criterion with fewer calls than the best continuous method in all four informative batch cells (two post-freeze). We recommend default pool selection and coverage checks for any selection.
papers.title_ja: 能動学習Kriging信頼性解析における内部最適化器：事前指定された比較と、未学習の失敗モードが残す非保守的な推定
papers.summary_ja: 能動学習Krigingにおける内部最適化器（連続最適化アルゴリズム）と候補プール選択法の性能を、11問の信頼性解析で比較した。結果、ハイブリッド群最適化は精度面で候補プール法に劣り、特に多スタートL-BFGS-Bでは未学習の失敗モードを残し、失敗確率を過小評価する傾向が顕著だった。この過小評価は誤差基準を満たすため検出されず、非保守的な結果を招くリスクがある。したがって、より少ない呼び出し回数で停止基準を満たす候補プール選択法と、カバレッジチェックの実施を推奨する。
papers.relevance_reason: Kriging（ガウス過程）と能動学習による信頼性解析の最適化手法比較であり、ML手法全般と実務的評価に直結する。

papers.title: CFD-driven symbolic regression of RANS transition models
papers.summary: Laminar-turbulent transition governs skin friction, heat transfer and losses in turbomachinery, yet Reynolds-averaged Navier-Stokes (RANS) transition models rely on empirical correlations and hand-calibrated activation functions whose structural deficiencies cannot be resolved by recalibration. We propose a CFD-driven sparse symbolic regression framework to learn interpretable, closed-form corrections to the production and destruction activation functions in the intermittency equation of the local, Galilean-invariant $k$-$\omega$-$\gamma$ model of Ge et al. Each correction combines a polynomial of a local pressure-gradient parameter, controlling amplitude and sign, with a bounded exponential of local flow features, controlling spatial support. This construction bounds the corrections without ad hoc limiters. Coefficients are identified by gradient-free optimization with the RANS solver in the loop, accelerated by POD-Kriging field surrogates, using mean-velocity data from wall-resolved large-eddy simulations (LES) of the ERCOFTAC T3 flat-plate cases. Elastic-net hyperparameters are selected automatically through bi-level optimization with leave-one-case-out cross-validation. The resulting model retains 11 of 21 candidate terms, compared with 20 under conventional grid-search tuning, while achieving comparable or slightly better accuracy on training and unseen cases. Both approaches recover the same leading-order correction. Applied without retraining to the transonic LS89 turbine cascade, far beyond the training envelope, the augmented model remains numerically robust and improves heat-transfer predictions at all four operating points, reducing errors by up to 70% where the baseline predicts premature transition under high freestream turbulence. Residual errors in transition onset and length highlight the limits of training on flat-plate data alone.
papers.title_ja: CFD駆動によるRANS遷移モデルのシンボリック回帰
papers.summary_ja: CFDシミュレーションとシンボリック回帰を用い、RANS遷移モデルの活性化関数に対する解釈可能な補正項を自動学習する枠組みを提案する。POD-Krigingによるサロゲートモデルで計算を高速化し、勾配なし最適化により係数を同定した。結果、候補項を大幅に削減しながら精度を維持し、未見ケースへの汎化性能も示した。
