papers.title: Low-Rank Clebsch--Gordan Coupling for Equivariant Spherical Forecasting
papers.summary: Spherical-harmonic neural operators provide an efficient representation for global forecasting, but their discretized pointwise nonlinearities can break rotational equivariance through aliasing. Clebsch-Gordan (CG) tensor products provide exactly equivariant interactions between spherical-harmonic representations, but their computational cost grows rapidly with spectral bandwidth and has limited their use at forecasting scale. We introduce LCG-SFNO, which combines low-rank CG interactions within a controlled low-degree band with coefficient-space residual propagation and an exactly projected quadratic nonlinearity, preserving SO(3) equivariance throughout the learned operator. To make the CG interaction practical, we further develop SSHCG, a sparse GPU implementation with a factorized alternative for wider coupled bands. On spherical shallow-water dynamics and the ERA5-based WeatherBench benchmark, LCG-SFNO reduces rotational error to numerical precision (more than three orders of magnitude below SFNO on shallow water and five orders of magnitude below it on WeatherBench), while matching SFNO on shallow-water forecasting and substantially improving forecast skill relative to SFNO on WeatherBench. Matched ablations show that CG coupling accelerates convergence, while SSHCG keeps the coupling to about 10 percent of a training step at the operating bandwidth, making exact equivariant coupling practical at forecasting scale.
papers.title_ja: 等変球面予測のための低ランク・クレブシュ-ゴルダン結合
papers.summary_ja: 球面調和ニューラルオペレータにおける回転等変性を保ちつつ計算コストを削減する手法「LCG-SFNO」を提案する。低ランクのクレブシュ-ゴルダン結合と係数空間の残差伝播を用い、SO(3)等変性を厳密に維持しながら非線形性を導入する。さらに、GPU向けスパース実装「SSHCG」により、予測スケールでの実用的な計算効率を実現した。浅水方程式およびWeatherBenchベンチマークにおいて、回転誤差を数値精度レベルまで低減し、予測精度も既存手法を上回る結果を示した。
papers.relevance_reason: ニューラルオペレータと物理情報モデルの高度な応用であり、効率化手法を含むため高関連。

papers.title: Boosted Physics-Informed Neural Networks for Solving Homogeneous and Non-Homogeneous Lane-Emden Type Equations
papers.summary: The Lane-Emden Equation is a class of nonlinear differential equations commonly used to model phenomena in astrophysics and mathematical physics, such as stellar structure and thermal behavior in polytropic gas spheres. This study presents a novel hybrid framework that integrates Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) with boosting methods to enhance the accuracy and robustness of solutions for Lane-Emden type differential equations. Standard PINNs leverage physical laws encoded within the loss function, but their predictive performance can be constrained by optimization challenges and approximation errors. To address this, we introduce a post-processing boosting stage where the residual errors from the PINN prediction are modeled using some regression algorithms - including LightGBM, Random Forest, XGBoost, and Support Vector Regression (SVR). The outputs from these boosted models are aggregated to generate a corrected, high-fidelity prediction. The proposed methodology is systematically validated through quantitative metrics and comparative analysis against the standard PINN baseline. The results demonstrate that the boosted PINN framework significantly reduces prediction error, and improves generalization, offering a powerful and flexible approach for solving scientific and engineering problems governed by differential equations.
papers.title_ja: 同種および非同種 Lane-Emden 型方程式の解法におけるブースティング強化物理情報ニューラルネットワーク
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、天体物理で重要な Lane-Emden 型微分方程式を解くためのハイブリッド手法を提案する。物理情報ニューラルネットワーク（PINN）の予測誤差を LightGBM や Random Forest などのブースティングアルゴリズムで補正する後処理段階を導入し、標準 PINN の最適化困難や近似誤差を低減する。定量評価により、このブースト PINN フレームワークが予測精度と汎化性能を大幅に向上させることを示した。微分方程式支配する科学・工学問題への適用可能性が高い。
papers.relevance_reason: PINN と ML 手法の組み合わせで物理方程式を高速・高精度に解く手法であり、サロゲートモデルや軌道計算への応用が期待できるため。

papers.title: A Surrogate Model for Variation-Aware Clock-Mesh Analysis and Design-Space Exploration using Graph Neural Networks
papers.summary: Clock meshes are widely used in high-performance VLSI systems to minimize skew and tolerate On-Chip Variation (OCV) in nanometer technologies. However, analyzing meshes is difficult because reconvergent paths and multi-source drivers prevent static timing analysis (STA) tools from handling mesh loops, making SPICE the industrial standard. SPICE simulations are accurate but slow, so clock-mesh synthesis relies on approximate models that overlook critical effects such as non-linear buffer driving caused by input slew and input skew. We propose a Graph Neural Network (GNN) based surrogate model of the clock mesh with a new graph representation and a new architecture that predicts power while also improving the delay and slew predictions at the sinks and capturing the skew histogram under OCV. Trained on SPICE data and tested on unseen real designs, our model achieves average errors of $3.40$~ps in delay, $4.14$~ps in slew and $4.46$~ps in skew, compared with $6.28$~ps, $12.35$~ps, and $11.62$~ps for our prior model, and $74.37$~ps delay and $27.51$~ps skew for the approximate method used in current state-of-the-art works. Our model predicts power within $3.4\%$ of SPICE on average, while delivering $18\times$-$1706\times$ speed-ups over the approximate method under OCV modeling, enabling faster and more accurate clock-mesh design-space exploration. A case study on a real design further shows that our surrogate model finds buffering candidates that, at a balanced tradeoff, improves $99^{\text{th}}$-percentile skew by $49.1\%$, reduces power by $25.7\%$, and reduces area by $37.3\%$ at the cost of a $6.8\%$ increase in $99^{\text{th}}$-percentile maximum slew as compared to the state-of-the-art work.
papers.title_ja: グラフニューラルネットワークを用いた変動認識型クロックメッシュ解析と設計空間探索のためのサロゲートモデル
papers.summary_ja: VLSI設計におけるクロックメッシュの解析において、SPICEシミュレーションの高速化と精度向上を目的としたグラフニューラルネットワーク（GNN）ベースのサロゲートモデルを提案する。従来の近似モデルでは捉えきれなかった非線形バッファ駆動や入力スルーの影響を考慮し、遅延・スルー・スキウの予測精度を大幅に改善した。SPICEデータで学習し、未知の実設計で検証した結果、既存手法比で最大1706倍の高速化と高い精度を達成した。さらに、このモデルを用いた設計空間探索により、スキウ・電力・面積のバランスを最適化し、実設計での性能向上を実証している。
papers.relevance_reason: サロゲートモデルとGNNによる高速化・最適化が関心と一致

papers.title: Reimagining Text-to-SQL: A Survey of Large Language Model Architectures and Strategies
papers.summary: Text-to-SQL systems translate natural language questions into executable SQL queries, democratizing access to relational data. Early approaches relied on handcrafted rules and template matching, while subsequent neural methods introduced encoder-decoder architectures, schema linking, and constrained decoding to handle increasingly complex queries. The emergence of large language models (LLMs), exemplified by systems such as ReFoRCE, Agentar-Scale-SQL, Snowflake's Arctic-Text2SQL-R1, and the modular XiYan-SQL framework, has dramatically advanced the field, pushing execution accuracy to new state-of-the-art levels on challenging benchmarks such as Spider, Spider 2.0, and BIRD. In parallel, modular frameworks decompose the task into sub-problems (schema retrieval, sketch-based generation, repair, and ranking), while agentic systems coordinate multiple specialized agents that communicate and dynamically allocate sub-tasks. This survey systematically reviews these LLM-driven approaches within a unified taxonomy of five paradigms (in-context learning, supervised and parameter-efficient fine-tuning, agentic and tool-augmented orchestration, retrieval-augmented generation, and reinforcement learning) and characterizes them by model granularity (monolithic vs. modular), level of supervision (zero-shot, fine-tuned, or reinforcement-based), and reasoning style (direct decoding vs. decomposed multi-step reasoning). We further analyze evaluation metrics, datasets, and open challenges, including domain generalization, efficiency, and real-world deployment, and we examine the role of the semantic layer in production systems. As LLMs increasingly access sensitive databases, we also discuss responsible AI practices. We survey over 100 papers and technical resources, focusing on work published between 2022 and 2026.
papers.title_ja: Text-to-SQLの再考：大規模言語モデルのアーキテクチャと戦略に関するサーベイ
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、自然言語からSQLクエリを生成するText-to-SQLシステムにおけるLLM活用手法を体系的にレビューする。インコンテキスト学習、ファインチューニング、エージェント型オーケストレーション、RAG、強化学習という5つのパラダイムを軸に、単一モデル型とモジュール型、推論スタイルの違いを整理した。SpiderやBIRDなどのベンチマークでの最新性能向上に加え、評価指標、ドメイン汎化、効率性、実務展開における課題や責任あるAIの実践についても論じる。2022年から2026年にかけて発表された100以上の論文を網羅し、LLMによるデータアクセスの民主化と技術的進化を俯瞰している。

papers.title: Neurons Are All You Need
papers.summary: For decades, artificial neural networks have operated under the assumption that durable, learned capability resides exclusively in adaptive synaptic parameters, primarily due to the established neurobiology of synaptic connectivity. This design forces models to remain stateless during deployment, incurring well-known limitations such as catastrophic forgetting and expensive retraining. However, recent neurobiological research by Glanzman and colleagues, and others, shows that memories can be transferred between individual organisms in a synaptically independent manner. Inspired by this research, we sought to demonstrate memory transfer of persistent memory between AI model instances, leveraging a neurocentric version of memory. In this paper, we propose NURESA (Neural Unit with Retentive Self-Adaptive Architecture), a novel neural layer that eschews sole reliance on synaptic weight updating by introducing persistent intra-unit memory as a first-class, computational primitive. By structurally separating computation from persistent memory, NURESA enables autonomous memory accumulation and consolidation into transferable stores of memory registers. Experiments across MLP, GPT-2, and modern frontier models like Qwen2.5 demonstrate qualitatively new capability: zero-shot transfer of learned capability into a naive model instance without retraining or access to the original training data; this transfer is enabled by a sparse set of parameters in NURESA's memory register that the model selects on its own based on which neurons were most active. The memory transfer capability of NURESA also protects against domain loss when transformer models undergo learning via fine-tuning. Finally, the memory transfer process completes in approximately one minute even for transformer models with millions to billions of parameters, producing a transfer file orders of magnitude smaller than the original model.
papers.title_ja: ニューロンこそがすべてである
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、シナプス重みの更新に依存しない永続的なユニット内メモリを計算の第一級プリミティブとして導入する新しいニューラル層NURESAを提案する。この設計により、学習済み能力を再学習や元データなしでゼロショット転移し、ファインチューニング時のドメイン損失を防止できる。MLPやGPT-2、Qwen2.5などのモデルで、数百万〜数十億パラメータのモデルでも約1分で転移ファイル生成が可能であることを示した。

papers.title: C3: Speech-Guided KV Retrieval for Long-Context SpeechLLM Inference
papers.summary: Speech language models encode audio at a much higher rate than text, causing the KV cache to dominate the memory, bandwidth, and decoding cost of long-form generation. KV retrieval can reduce per-step access by attending to only a query-dependent subset of the cache, but existing methods are designed primarily for text and do not account for the structure of audio attention. We first show that retrieval errors may compound autoregressively into generation drift. We then analyze full audio attention during long-form generation and identify three properties relevant to retrieval: unequal attention concentration across query heads, non-contiguous audio support, and temporal continuity across decoding steps. Guided by these observations, we propose $C^3$(Cluster-Compete-Compete), which organizes audio KVs in a hierarchical key-space index, lets query heads sharing a KV head compete for a common retrieval budget, and adaptively reallocates retrieval resolution through paired split-merge updates. Across long-form speech recognition, translation, and summarization on four SpeechLLMs, $C^3$ achieves the strongest overall performance among retrieval methods under comparable final-KV access budgets, with particularly large gains in the tight-budget regime, while improving long-context decoding efficiency and accelerator-memory scaling.
papers.title_ja: C3: 長文脈SpeechLLM推論のための音声ガイド型KV検索
papers.summary_ja: 音声言語モデル（SpeechLLM）におけるKVキャッシュのメモリ・帯域幅負荷を軽減するため、音声アテンションの構造特性を活用した新しいKV検索手法C3を提案する。既存のテキスト向け手法が音声の非連続性や時間的連続性を考慮していない問題を指摘し、階層的なキー空間インデックスとヘッド間の競合メカニズムを導入した。4つのSpeechLLMを用いた長文認識・翻訳・要約タスクで、同等のアクセス予算下で最良の性能と推論効率の向上を実証した。

papers.title: SPARK: Self-Correcting Embodied Memory via Physical Re-Observation
papers.summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems have seen growing adoption in embodied settings as language-queryable memories of the environment. However, existing approaches often assume a reliable single-episode knowledge base (KB) or accumulate observations across episodes without correcting prior errors. Such errors can persist through incorrect semantic labels, inaccurate object positions, and inconsistent spatial relationships. To address this, we present SPARK, a corrective multi-episode framework for embodied RAG. After the first episode, a semantic critic flags regions of the KB, a targeted planner generates revisits, and a selective merge adds, removes, or replaces KB information based on the new observations. We evaluate SPARK on four outdoor AirSim maps under two degraded viewpoint conditions, using perception-built KBs, a visibility-constrained oracle used only for evaluation, and a fixed set of 158 embodied question answering (EQA) questions scored before and after correction. A single corrective episode improves downstream EQA on every map under both conditions while storing 13-41% fewer objects than append-only updating, with gains up to 2.7x on one map-condition pair. Extending correction through Episode 4 brings every map above the EQA performance of its undegraded reference. Ablations show that the critic's three signals each contribute to performance, that targeted revisits achieve a larger mean gain than untargeted ones under the same budget, and that selective merging achieves gains comparable to append-only updating with a smaller KB. Overall, SPARK demonstrates the value of correcting embodied memory through targeted re-observation, particularly as embodied systems scale and the risk of accumulated errors increases.
papers.title_ja: SPARK: 物理的再観察による自己修正型エンボディドメモリ
papers.summary_ja: エンボディド環境におけるRAGシステムで生じる知識ベース（KB）の誤り蓄積問題を解決するため、物理的再観察に基づく自己修正フレームワークSPARKを提案する。セマンティッククリティクがKB内の不整合を特定し、ターゲットプランナーが再訪問経路を生成することで、選択的マージを通じてKBを動的に更新・修正する。AirSim環境での評価により、単回の修正エピソードでEQA性能を最大2.7倍向上させ、かつオブジェクト数を13-41%削減できることを示した。この手法は、エンボディドAIのスケール拡大に伴う誤り累積リスクを低減し、より正確な環境認識を実現する。
papers.relevance_reason: RAGとエージェント設計、特にメモリ管理の効率化と精度向上に直結する手法

papers.title: Unlearning by Extrapolating a Shrink-and-Heal Lookahead
papers.summary: Unlearning aims to make a large language model behave like one retrained without its forget set. Prevailing likelihood-suppression objectives, however, lack an explicit forgetting target: they continually reward lower forget-set likelihood, making forgetting sensitive to the optimization budget. We address this limitation by estimating the direction toward the oracle without training it. Our key idea is to shrink the fine-tuned model toward its pre-fine-tuning weights and briefly re-learn the retain set, thereby removing the forget-specific contribution; in the linearized regime, this shrink-and-heal lookahead moves the model a fixed fraction of the way to the retrained model, its unique fixed point. Our method, SHIFT, extrapolates the lookahead's per-token changes into distillation targets and iteratively refines them. Evaluated against eleven baselines under a unified OpenUnlearning protocol, SHIFT achieves the highest aggregate score across all TOFU settings and the closest oracle alignment, 3.7x closer on average than the next-best method; on MUSE, it preserves the most retain knowledge. Under larger optimization budgets, baselines overshoot the oracle, while SHIFT remains near it, even under relearning attacks.
papers.title_ja: 縮小と修復の先読みを外挿するアンラーニング
papers.summary_ja: 大規模言語モデル（LLM）のアンラーニングにおいて、忘却セットの尤度を抑える従来の手法が最適化予算に敏感な問題を解決する。提案手法SHIFTは、ファインチューニング済みモデルを事前学習重みへ縮小し、保持セットを短時間再学習することで、忘却特有の寄与を除去する「縮小と修復」の先読みを行う。この線形化された状態の変化を蒸留ターゲットとして外挿し、反復的に洗練させることで、オラクル（理想的な再学習モデル）への近接度を大幅に向上させる。11種のベースラインと比較した評価では、SHIFTは最も高い総合スコアとオラクルへの近接度を達成し、再学習攻撃下でも安定した性能を示した。
papers.relevance_reason: LLMの効率化・推論高速化・RAGと密接に関連するアンラーニング手法

papers.title: Hacking or Just Failing? A More Capable LLM Monitor Better Separates Reward Hacking from Honest Failure
papers.summary: An agent's visible score can exceed its real progress because it gamed the score or because it simply made mistakes, so a useful reward-hacking monitor must tell the two apart. We built a sandboxed task in which an agent can game a completion score, labelled every episode by replaying it and repairing the final state counterfactually, and ran five pre-registered studies. On 60 episodes from a Llama 3.1 8B agent, small local monitors (Llama 3B and 8B) did not separate exploit attempts from honest failures with the same score gap: prompt changes traded missed exploits for false alarms, and the pre-registered primary monitor reached AUC 0.64. On identical inputs, Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite, which completed 9/10 clean tasks against 2/10 for the 8B model, met our pre-registered criterion (AUC 0.80, 95% interval [0.66, 0.93]; 1/35 honest failures flagged); with only 14 exploit episodes, this estimate is uncertain. On an exploit that no prompt names, Gemini usually described the action correctly yet never flagged it, in 5 and then 25 new episodes, even when manipulation was defined by its effect on the score. Given the full trace, the 8B monitor flagged all 25 replication episodes and none of 25 honest look-alikes, but its explanations described actions that had not occurred; given additional structured evidence, it also flagged 15 of the 25 look-alikes. A two-rule deterministic check caught every known exploit. We release the environment, labels, pre-registrations and per-judgement logs.
papers.title_ja: ハッキングか単なる失敗か？より高機能なLLMモニターによる報酬ハッキングと誠実な失敗の分離
papers.summary_ja: エージェントのスコアが実際の進捗を上回る原因が報酬ハッキング（意図的な不正）か単なるエラーかを区別するLLMモニターの性能を評価した。Llama 3.1 8Bなどの小型モデルではAUC 0.64と識別精度が低かった一方、Gemini 3.1 Flash-LiteはAUC 0.80と基準を満たしたが、未知のハッキング手法への検出能力には限界があることが示された。また、完全なトレース情報を与えると小型モデルも検出可能だが、説明の正確性に問題があることが判明した。本論文は、エージェント設計における評価手法の信頼性向上と、ハルシネーション対策としての監視機構の設計指針を提供する。
papers.relevance_reason: LLMエージェント設計と評価手法・ハルシネーション対策に直結

papers.title: Do Multimodal Models Decide Consistently on Equivalent Optical Spectra?
papers.summary: A spectrum can be given to a model as a table in nanometers or as a plot in photon energy, and the decision should not depend on which one it sees. When the data needed for an answer are missing, the model should say so. We test representation invariance and abstention on measured optical spectra of silicon metasurfaces (MOCLIP) and gold nanoparticles, with labels computed from the data. Each spectrum is shown as four tables (nm, $\mu$m, scientific notation, eV) and two plots (nm, eV), and partial spectra remove data inside or outside the queried range. We evaluate the decision models d3-nano and Jev 1.13, three GPT-6 Luna configurations and the Qwen3.5-2B base model. Changing only the representation moves accuracy by up to 41 percentage points within one model, mostly on photon-energy tables and plots. With the same evidence, asking in photon energy instead of wavelength helps some model-view pairs by 16-50 points and hurts others by up to 25. When the relevant extremum is removed, unadapted models rarely answer "undetermined". LoRA fine-tuning of d3-nano improves comparisons on the trained table formats, but much of its gain on unanswerable questions comes from a shortcut: it abstains whenever the input is truncated. Training with answerable truncations avoids the shortcut in all six seeds, with a 90-100 point gap between abstention after inside and outside cuts on held-out structures; with the same amount of extra original-task data, five of six seeds keep the shortcut. On gold spectra the two training sets perform similarly. Multimodal language models used for scientific decisions should be tested on equivalent representations and on missing evidence, not only on average accuracy. We release the tasks, per-response results and analysis code.
papers.title_ja: マルチモーダルモデルは等価な光学スペクトルに対して一貫して判断を下すか？
papers.summary_ja: 本研究では、光学スペクトルの表現形式（ナノメートル表、eVプロットなど）やデータ欠損の有無が、マルチモーダルLLMの判断精度に与える影響を評価した。結果、表現形式の変更だけで精度が最大41ポイント変動し、モデルが表現不変性を保てていないことが判明した。また、データ不足時に「判断不能」と回答する棄権能力は低く、LoRAファインチューニングによる改善もショートカット学習に依存する傾向が見られた。科学的判断におけるモデルの信頼性を評価するため、平均精度だけでなく表現の等価性と証拠欠如への対応をテストすべきと提言している。
papers.relevance_reason: LLMのハルシネーション対策・評価手法・科学データ処理への応用が関心に合致

papers.title: CLiS: Plug-and-Play Attention Acceleration for Video Diffusion on TPUs via Certified Stabilization
papers.summary: High-resolution video diffusion relies on attention over long token sequences, making attention efficiency critical to generation latency. Our analysis identifies repeated maximum reductions and accumulator rescaling in online softmax as a bottleneck in long-context TPU attention. We propose CLiS (Certified Loop-invariant Stabilization), a training-free, plug-and-play optimization for video diffusion inference. CLiS fixes per-row stabilizers before the KV loop and certifies numerical safety per head, falling back to online softmax when certification fails. It integrates into existing fused-attention kernels without changing model weights or architecture. On Wan 2.2 and LTX-2 across TPU v6e and TPU7x, CLiS reduces diffusion transformer (DiT) step latency by up to 19.6% relative to tuned online softmax without measurable quality loss. Controlled TPU adaptations of prior GPU stabilization methods show performance or numerical-safety limitations. Preliminary causal LLM experiments also show up to 13.5% higher training throughput in continued pretraining and 7.7% in supervised fine-tuning.
papers.title_ja: CLiS: 認証済み安定化によるTPU上の動画拡散モデル向けプラグアンドプレイ型アテンション高速化
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、TPU上で動画拡散モデルの推論を高速化する手法CLiSを提案する。オンラインsoftmaxにおける反復的な最大値削減とアキュムレータの再スケーリングがボトルネックであることを特定し、KVループ前に安定化係数を固定することで計算負荷を低減する。数値的安全性をヘッド単位で認証し、失敗時は従来の手法にフォールバックする仕組みにより、モデル重みの変更なしで統合可能である。Wan 2.2やLTX-2での実験により、DiTステップのレイテンシを最大19.6%削減しつつ品質劣化なしを実現し、LLMの学習スループット向上にも有効性を示した。
papers.relevance_reason: LLM推論高速化とTPU最適化が関心と一致

papers.title: VoirDire: Counterfactual Calibration for Reliable LLM-as-a-Judge Aggregation
papers.summary: LLM-as-a-judge systems often aggregate multiple judges to improve evaluation reliability. However, judge agreement can reflect shared biases toward verbosity, formatting, or fluency rather than the intended evaluation target. Addressing these shared biases is challenging because observational judge outputs alone cannot distinguish agreement driven by target quality from agreement driven by nuisance attributes. We introduce VoirDire, an intervention-calibrated aggregation method for LLM-judge panels. VoirDire applies controlled interventions that vary specified surface attributes while aiming to preserve the evaluation target; it then uses paired changes in judge scores to identify nuisance-sensitive directions. It attenuates these directions and selects aggregation weights that retain variation across items while penalizing sensitivity to the interventions, making the final consensus less dependent on superficial features. We show theoretically that observational judge outputs alone cannot identify which shared direction is target-relevant, while paired interventions provide the contrast needed to identify nuisance-sensitive variation. We evaluate VoirDire on 12 datasets spanning continuous scoring, binary classification, and pairwise preference. Compared with the existing LLM-judge aggregation baselines, VoirDire reduces MAE by up to 26.8% on continuous-score tasks and improves accuracy by up to 5.3 percentage points on binary and preference tasks. These findings suggest that counterfactual interventions provide an additional means of improving the reliability and controllability of LLM-based evaluation beyond merely relying on observed judge agreement.
papers.title_ja: VoirDire: 信頼性の高いLLMジャッジ集約のための反実仮想キャリブレーション
papers.summary_ja: LLM-as-a-Judgeシステムにおいて、複数のジャッジの合意が本来の評価対象ではなく冗長性や形式などの表面的なバイアスに起因している問題を解決する手法を提案する。本手法は、評価対象を維持しつつ表面的属性を操作する介入を行い、ジャッジスコアのペア変化からノイズに敏感な方向性を特定・減衰させることで、より信頼性の高いコンセンサスを得る。理論的に、観察データだけではターゲット関連の方向性を識別できないことを示し、反実仮想介入の必要性を論証する。12データセットでの評価により、連続スコアタスクでMAEを最大26.8%低減し、バイナリ分類やペアワイズ選好タスクで精度を最大5.3ポイント向上させることを実証した。
papers.relevance_reason: LLM評価の信頼性向上とハルシネーション対策に直結する手法

papers.title: Conic Certification of Transformer Attention
papers.summary: Attention is the computational core of large language models, yet the verifiers that bound how far an attention head's output can move under input perturbations give no guarantee on how loose their bounds are. A weak certificate therefore cannot be told apart from a fragile model. We develop a conic programming theory of attention certification that supplies this guarantee. We prove that the difficulty lies not in the softmax but in the bilinear interaction of a varying query with the keys. This interaction makes certification NP-hard over boxes and inapproximable once the attention logits can move by a constant amount. A fixed query or listed token substitutions, by contrast, make the exact worst case efficiently computable. An exponential cone moment relaxation then certifies a head with an error bounded quadratically in the perturbation radius by computable quantities, an order that cannot be improved. We also show that relaxations that treat a network one operation at a time, linear bound propagation among them, pay on second-order terms a sum of per-operation maxima instead of one coupled maximum. Computational results on GPT-2 indicate that the theory carries over to a trained model. Against exact worst cases with the query fixed, the certificate attains the predicted second-order accuracy. It is tighter than linear bound propagation on every head, and the looseness of bound propagation tracks the predicted per-operation excess.
papers.title_ja: Transformerアテンションの円錐認証
papers.summary_ja: 大規模言語モデル（LLM）のアテンション機構における入力摂動に対する出力変化の上限を、円錐計画理論を用いて厳密に保証する手法を提案する。アテンションの双線形相互作用が認証をNP困難にすることを証明し、指数円錐モーメント緩和により摂動半径の2次オーダーで誤差を有界にする認証法を導出する。GPT-2での計算結果により、この理論が学習済みモデルに適用可能であり、従来の線形境界伝播よりも緊密な保証を提供することを示した。
papers.relevance_reason: LLMの推論安定性・検証手法であり、実務応用可能な評価手法に該当

papers.title: FB-MOAC: A Reinforcement Learning Algorithm for Forward-Backward Markov Decision Processes
papers.summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) algorithms are effective in solving problems that can be modeled as Markov decision processes (MDPs). These algorithms primarily target forward MDPs whose dynamics evolve over time from an initial state. However, several important problems in different scenarios including stochastic control and network systems exhibit both a forward and a backward dynamics. As a consequence, they cannot be expressed as a standard MDP, thereby calling for a novel theory for RL in this context. Accordingly, this work introduces the concept of Forward-Backward Markov Decision Processes (FB-MDPs) for multi-objective problems, develops a novel theoretical framework to characterize their optimal solutions, and proposes a general forward-backward step-wise template that allows to adapt RL algorithms for FB-MDP problems. A Forward Backward Multi Objective Actor Critic (FB-MOAC) algorithm is introduced accordingly to obtain optimal policies with guaranteed convergence and a competitive rate with respect to standard approaches in RL. FB-MOAC is evaluated on diverse use cases in the context of mathematical finance and mobile resource management. The obtained results show that FB-MOAC outperforms the state of the art across different metrics, highlighting its ability to learn and maximize rewards.
papers.title_ja: FB-MOAC: 前後方向マルコフ決定過程のための強化学習アルゴリズム
papers.summary_ja: 本研究は、時間的に前方と後方の両方のダイナミクスを持つ問題を扱うための「前後方向マルコフ決定過程（FB-MDP）」という新概念を提案する。従来の標準的なMDPでは表現できない確率制御やネットワークシステムなどの複雑な問題を対象とし、最適解を特徴づける理論的枠組みを構築した。さらに、収束性を保証しつつ標準的な強化学習手法と競争力のある学習速度を実現する多目的アクタークリティックアルゴリズム「FB-MOAC」を開発した。数学的金融やモバイルリソース管理などの多様なユースケースでの評価により、既存手法を上回る報酬最大化能力を示した。
papers.relevance_reason: 強化学習の新手法であり、ユーザーのML手法全般への関心に高適合

papers.title: Learning to bid and bundle: a posterior-sampling agent for online retail
papers.summary: An online retailer launching a perishable product bids for sponsored-search clicks, discounts a bundle with an always-stocked staple and displays its remaining stock, which raises willingness to pay. It knows neither how clicks respond to its bid nor how strong and dispersed its market is, and learns both over repeated seasons from data its own decisions censor: a zero bid reveals nothing about paid clicks, and choices follow only clicks. We design a posterior-sampling agent for it. Each period it draws a market from an exact posterior and posts the bid and discount of that market's exactly solved season plan, so every action is one a fully informed seller could take. In a simulated online florist it has the lowest regret averaged over markets. In weak markets it gives up 12% to 23% of one season's revenue over 500 seasons, four to seven times less than drawing once per season. A planner acting on point estimates can stop bidding and never learn that bidding pays. The agent escapes after about three seasons on average, against fifty with one draw per season. Where displayed scarcity keeps willingness to pay above the posted price, the discount needs no learning. Customers waiting for the discount to return to its recent level look like lost sales, so frequent waiting makes the agent underrate its market. One discount per season removes waiting at a cost of 5.9% of clairvoyant revenue in a weak market and none in a strong one.
papers.title_ja: 入札とバンドルを学習する：オンライン小売のための後方サンプリングエージェント
papers.summary_ja: オンライン小売におけるスポンサー検索クリックの入札と、在庫表示を伴うバンドル割引の最適化問題を扱う。市場の反応や分散が不明な状況下で、自身の意思決定によってデータが検閲される（ゼロ入札では有料クリックの情報が得られない等）課題に対し、厳密な事後分布から市場をサンプリングし、その市場で最適解が得られる行動を実行する後方サンプリングエージェントを提案する。シミュレーションにより、この手法が平均的な後悔（regret）を最小化し、特に弱い市場において従来の手法より大幅に収益損失を軽減できることを示す。また、点推定に基づく計画者が学習を停止する問題に対し、本エージェントは約3シーズンで脱出できることを確認した。
papers.relevance_reason: ベイズ最適化・後方サンプリングというML手法と、意思決定の高速化・効率化が関心に合致

papers.title: OPINE: Orthogonal Projection in Invertible Nonlinear Embeddings for Turbulent Flows
papers.summary: Proper orthogonal decomposition (POD) represents physical fields with orthogonal modes ordered by variance, so that one decomposition gives reduced coordinates in every dimension, but it needs many modes when the data lie near a curved manifold. Nonlinear autoencoders are more compact, but their information loss happens inside a nonlinear encoder, and a model trained with one latent dimension gives no model with a smaller one. We introduce Orthogonal Projection in Invertible Nonlinear Embeddings (OPINE), which learns an invertible nonlinear change of coordinates and performs POD in the transformed coordinates. Because the map is invertible, all information loss occurs in the POD projection, and ordering its basis after training gives reduced coordinates of every smaller dimension from a single model. Training alternates gradient updates of the map with a damped update that tracks the evolving POD subspace, and we prove that this update converges locally to the exact POD subspace. We evaluate OPINE on synthetic manifolds, chaotic Kuramoto-Sivashinsky dynamics, forced Burgers turbulence, two-dimensional Kolmogorov flow, and three-dimensional minimal channel flow. OPINE is more accurate than POD at every tested retained dimension above one, and on the Kuramoto-Sivashinsky and Burgers dynamics, it is more accurate than convolutional and fully connected autoencoders by more than two orders of magnitude at the largest retained dimension.
papers.title_ja: OPINE: 乱流における可逆非線形埋め込みによる直交射影
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、乱流などの複雑な物理場を効率的に縮約するための新しい手法OPINEを提案する。可逆な非線形座標変換を学習し、その変換空間内で固有直交分解（POD）を行うことで、単一のモデルから任意の低次元表現を導出可能にする。この手法は、従来のPODや非線形オートエンコーダーと比較し、特に高次元の保持次元において精度が2桁以上高いことを、Kuramoto-Sivashinsky方程式やBurgers乱流などの数値シミュレーションで実証した。
papers.relevance_reason: サロゲートモデル・縮約モデルの高度な手法であり、物理系への適用例を含むため高関連。

papers.title: ProLand: A New Infeasible Manifold Optimization Method for LoRA Fine-Tuning
papers.summary: Low-rank adaptation (LoRA) enables parameter-efficient fine-tuning but can suffer from redundant basis directions. Constraining the basis factor to the Stiefel manifold addresses this redundancy through orthonormality. Landing methods allow temporarily infeasible iterates to explore a neighborhood of the manifold while progressively restoring orthogonality without per-step retractions. To improve optimization efficiency while retaining this flexibility, we introduce ProLand (Product-space Landing), a retraction-free optimizer that combines coordinated factor updates with Muon-style spectral directions. By designing the updates in the space of the represented weight increment, ProLand separates objective optimization from orthogonality restoration, supporting efficient feasibility recovery. This coordinated construction also enables Muon-style directions to guide objective optimization while preserving that separation. Experiments cover four GLUE validation tasks on DeBERTa-v3-base and seven language benchmarks on Qwen2.5-3B, Llama-3.2-3B, and Moonlight-16B-A3B across multiple adapter ranks. Across these 11 tasks, ProLand achieves the highest average score among the compared methods in every tested encoder and decoder model-rank configuration.
papers.title_ja: ProLand: LoRAファインチューニングのための新しい不可行多様体最適化手法
papers.summary_ja: LoRAの冗長な基底方向を解消するため、Stiefel多様体上の直交性を維持しつつ、一時的に不可行解を許容する「Landing」手法を拡張した最適化器ProLandを提案する。重み増分空間での座標更新とMuon様スペクトル方向を組み合わせることで、目的関数の最適化と直交性の回復を分離し、毎ステップの再traction（射影）を不要にする。DeBERTa-v3-baseやQwen2.5-3Bなど複数モデル・タスクで比較し、全設定において比較対象手法の中で平均スコアが最高であることを示した。
papers.relevance_reason: LLMの効率化・LoRA最適化に直結する手法

papers.title: Optimistic Gradient Algorithms with Randomized Coordinate and Variance Reduction Strategies for Composite Inclusions
papers.summary: In this paper, we consider a class of possibly nonmonotone finite-sum composite inclusions in which evaluating all components or updating all coordinates at every iteration can be computationally expensive. We develop two optimistic gradient frameworks that combine variance reduction with randomized block-coordinate updates. The first framework applies under a blockwise average Lipschitz continuity condition and the existence of a weak-Minty solution. It achieves an $\mathcal{O}(1/k)$ convergence rate for the expected squared residual, and its iterates converge almost surely under mild additional conditions. The second framework relies on a backward-forward reformulation under average co-coercivity and co-hypomonotonicity. It achieves faster $\mathcal{O}(1/k^2)$ and $o(1/k^2)$ rates for the expected squared residual, as well as $o(1/k^2)$ almost-sure rates. For both frameworks, we provide a generic condition on the stochastic estimator that covers mini-batch, loopless SVRG, and a generalized JacSketch-type estimator, and we derive the corresponding oracle complexities under importance-based block sampling. In particular, in highly heterogeneous regimes, the L-SVRG and JacSketch variants attain $\mathcal{O}\big(n + n^{2/3}\epsilon^{-2}\big)$ and $\mathcal{O}\big(n + n^{2/3}\epsilon^{-1}\big)$ oracle complexities for the nonaccelerated and accelerated methods, respectively. Numerical experiments illustrate the effects of variance reduction and block-coordinate sampling, and compare the proposed methods with existing baselines.
papers.title_ja: 複合包含問題におけるランダム化座標と分散低減戦略を用いた楽観的勾配アルゴリズム
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、計算コストの高い複合包含問題（finite-sum composite inclusions）に対し、分散低減とランダム化ブロック座標更新を組み合わせる2つの楽観的勾配フレームワークを提案する。第1の手法は弱Minty解の存在下でO(1/k)の収束率を、第2の手法は平均共強性条件下でO(1/k^2)の高速収束率を達成する。ミニバッチやSVRG、JacSketchなどの確率推定器を統一的に扱い、重要度ベースのブロックサンプリング下でのオラクル複雑度を導出する。数値実験により、分散低減とブロック座標サンプリングの効果を実証し、既存手法との比較を行う。
papers.relevance_reason: 機械学習の最適化手法全般（分散低減・座標降下）に深く関連

papers.title: Hi-CoLA: High Confidence Lower Bound Approximation Based Reinforcement Learning for Flex-Route Transit Operation Control
papers.summary: This paper studies safe policy improvement for real-time operation control of flex-route transit (FRT) systems, where robustness is critical and any performance decrease is undesirable. While reinforcement learning (RL) has shown strong empirical success, its adoption remains limited in safety and cost critical applications, such as intelligent transportation, since learned policies lack statistically certified performance guarantees before deployment. In this paper, we propose the High Confidence Lower Bound Approximation (Hi-CoLA) RL framework, which combines importance sampling and concentration inequalities with a differentiable surrogate network to efficiently estimate the high-confidence performance lower bound and optimize it via policy gradient for robust performance improvement. On the FRT operation control problem, Hi-CoLA outperforms state-of-the-art offline and safe RL methods in both average and tail-risk performance. A case study on an actual route in Chicago, implemented in the SUMO simulator, serves as a proof of concept. Hi-CoLA enhances real-time FRT control with guaranteed performance and is broadly applicable to other safety critical decision-making scenarios.
papers.title_ja: Hi-CoLA: 高信頼度下限近似に基づくフレックスルート交通運営制御のための強化学習
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、安全かつコスト重視のフレックスルート交通（FRT）システムにおけるリアルタイム運営制御向けに、Hi-CoLA という強化学習フレームワークを提案する。重要性サンプリングと集中不等式を用い、微分可能なサロゲートネットワークで高信頼度の性能下限を効率的に推定し、ポリシーグラデーションにより最適化することで、デプロイ前の統計的保証付き性能向上を実現する。シカゴの実路線を SUMO シミュレータで検証した結果、既存のオフライン RL や安全 RL 手法を上回る平均性能とテールリスク性能を示した。

papers.title: Beyond $L_\infty$-Norm Sets: Synthesizing Interpretable Non-Uniform Uncertainty Sets for Evaluation-Time State-Adversarial Robustness
papers.summary: Deep reinforcement learning (DRL) agents are vulnerable to perturbations of their observed state inputs. Prior works often constrain state adversaries with $L_p$-norm uncertainty sets and evaluate policy performance under the resulting perturbations. However, in continuous control tasks like robotics control, different state dimensions have distinct physical meanings and influence policy behavior to different degrees, which $L_p$-norm sets fail to capture or explain. Moreover, it is important to identify when and along which state dimensions a policy is vulnerable, independently of the algorithm used to train it. In this paper, we focus on evaluation-time attacks applied to pretrained policies. We propose \textbf{P}erformance-\textbf{D}egradation \textbf{N}on-\textbf{U}niform \textbf{U}ncertainty \textbf{S}et (\method{}), an interpretable formulation of uncertainty sets for state perturbations. \method{} is state-dependent, dimension-wise non-uniform, and can be synthesized online during policy evaluation. We first formulate an ideal constrained optimization problem for \method{} computation, then introduce a surrogate constraint to make the problem tractable. Experiments across multiple continuous-control environments, policy algorithms, and state attacks show that \method{} reveals variation in policy sensitivity across states and dimensions, while its performance degradation is moderately controlled.
papers.title_ja: L∞ノルム集合を超えて：評価時の状態敵対的頑健性のための解釈可能な非一様不確実性集合の合成
papers.summary_ja: 深層強化学習エージェントの状態入力に対する敵対的攻撃に対し、従来のLpノルム制約では捉えきれない次元ごとの物理的意味や影響度の非対称性を考慮した新しい不確実性集合「PNDUUS」を提案する。この手法は状態依存かつ次元ごとに非一様であり、ポリシー評価時にオンラインで合成可能である。理想の制約付き最適化問題を定式化し、計算可能性を高めるためのサロゲート制約を導入することで、ポリシーの脆弱性がどの状態・どの次元で顕在化するかを解釈可能に特定する。複数の連続制御環境での実験により、ポリシーの感度のばらつきを可視化しつつ、性能劣化を適度に制御できることを示した。
papers.relevance_reason: 強化学習とサロゲート制約の活用が関心に合致

papers.title: Hierarchical Asynchronous Federated Learning over Space-Air-Ground Integrated Networks
papers.summary: With the emerging 6G paradigm where AI services operate over decentralized and resource-constrained edge infrastructure, performance of distributed learning algorithms remains a significant challenge. This paper proposes HAFL, a Low Earth Orbit (LEO) satellite-assisted hierarchical asynchronous Federated Learning (FL) framework, enabling resource-limited terrestrial clients to collaborate via Ground-Satellite Links (GSLs). Within this framework, LEO satellites serve multiple roles: as edge servers aggregating and broadcasting models, as clients accelerating training, and as high-throughput relays managing inter-satellite routing through Inter-Satellite Links (ISLs). Unlike conventional synchronous Jacobian-type updates, HAFL employs asynchronous Gauss-Seidel-type updates to enhance convergence speed. We provide theoretical convergences for convex, strongly convex, and nonconvex objectives, respectively, and formulate optimization problems to jointly determine optimal hyperparameters to minimize global training latency. Evaluations demonstrate that HAFL achieves faster initial convergence and comparable final performance for benchmark DNNs and datasets, offering promising FL systems across remote areas with 6G technologies, but much less global rounds and communication cost.
papers.title_ja: 宇宙・航空・地上統合ネットワークにおける階層的非同期連合学習
papers.summary_ja: 6G環境における分散学習の課題に対し、低軌道衛星（LEO）を活用した階層的な非同期連合学習フレームワーク「HAFL」を提案する。本手法では、衛星がエッジサーバー、クライアント、中継の役割を担い、従来の同期型更新ではなく非同期ガウス・サイデル型更新を採用することで収束速度を向上させる。凸・非凸目的関数に対する理論的収束性を証明し、グローバルな学習遅延を最小化するハイパーパラメータの最適化問題を定式化している。ベンチマーク評価により、初期収束が速く、通信コストとラウンド数が大幅に削減されることを示した。
papers.relevance_reason: 衛星通信と機械学習の組み合わせだが、軌道力学やLLM効率化の核心とは異なる

papers.title: ParaBlock++: Communication-Computation Parallel Blockwise Hierarchical Federated Learning
papers.summary: In the emerging 6G paradigm, where AI-driven services operate over decentralized and resource-constrained infrastructures, the convergence of distributed learning algorithms remains a significant challenge. This paper introduces $\mathrm{ParaBlock}$++, a low Earth orbit (LEO) satellite-assisted hierarchical federated learning (HFL) framework, enabling resource-limited terrestrial clients to collaboratively engage in federated learning (FL) via ground-satellite links (GSLs) supported by LEO satellite megaconstellations. Within this architecture, LEO satellites serve multiple roles: as edge servers aggregating and broadcasting models, as clients accelerating training, and as high-throughput relays managing inter-satellite routing through inter-satellite links (ISLs). Departing from conventional synchronous Jacobian-type updates, $\mathrm{ParaBlock}$++ employs asynchronous BCD-type updates to enhance convergence speed. We provide theoretical convergence guarantees for convex, strongly convex, and non-convex objectives, and formulate optimization problems to determine optimal cluster resource allocation and model partitioning for minimizing global training latency. Experimental evaluations demonstrate that $\mathrm{ParaBlock}$++ achieves faster initial convergence and comparable final performance for deep neural networks (DNNs) such as ResNet-18, offering promising directions for federated learning across geographically remote areas enabled by 6G technologies, but much less global rounds and communication cost.
papers.title_ja: ParaBlock++: 通信と計算を並列化するブロック単位の階層型連合学習
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、LEO衛星コンステレーションを活用した6G環境向けの階層型連合学習フレームワーク「ParaBlock++」を提案する。衛星をエッジサーバー、クライアント、リレーとして多角的に活用し、従来の同期型更新ではなく非同期BCD型更新を採用することで収束速度を向上させる。凸・非凸目的関数に対する理論的収束保証を示すとともに、グローバルな訓練遅延を最小化するためのクラスタリソース配分とモデル分割の最適化問題を定式化している。ResNet-18を用いた実験では、初期収束が速く、最終性能も同等でありながら、グローバルラウンド数と通信コストを大幅に削減できることを示した。

papers.title: Strict Separation of Antiperiodic Degeneracy Curves for Elliptic Euler and Lagrangian Solutions
papers.summary: We prove strict separation of antiperiodic degeneracy curves associated with elliptic Euler and Lagrangian solutions of the planar three-body problem. For every eccentricity $0<e<1$, each Euler pair issuing from a common circular parameter is strictly ordered in the extended family $\beta>0$, and the two Lagrangian curves remain disjoint. Every antiperiodic degeneracy point in these families with $0<e<1$ has a one-dimensional full kernel. Rotation and reflection decomposition yield, for each model, two half-integer Fourier block operators with identical tails and different first blocks. In the Euler case, a positive definite first-block perturbation gives a definite connecting crossing form; a spectral-flow rectangle and sectorwise index counts then force strict separation. In the Lagrangian case, exact tail elimination and an explicit estimate for a two-dimensional Schur complement exclude simultaneous degeneracy in the two reflection sectors.
papers.title_ja: 楕円オイラー解とラグランジュ解における反周期縮退曲線の厳密な分離
papers.summary_ja: 平面三体問題における楕円軌道解（オイラー解とラグランジュ解）について、反周期縮退曲線が厳密に分離することを証明した。偏心率0<e<1の範囲で、オイラーペアは拡張された族内で厳密に順序付けられ、ラグランジュ曲線は互いに交差しないことを示した。回転と反射の分解を用いて、各モデルで半整数フーリエブロック演算子を導出し、スペクトルフローやシュア補元による推定を通じて同時縮退の不可能性を論証した。
papers.relevance_reason: 三体問題という軌道力学の関心に該当するが、機械学習やサロゲートモデルの要素は含まれていないため。

papers.title: Lyapunov-Schmidt reduction for periodic orbits of implicit discrete dynamical systems
papers.summary: We derive bifurcation equations for periodic orbits of autonomous and periodically non-autonomous implicit discrete systems in arbitrary finite dimension. Cyclic Lyapunov--Schmidt reduction gives recursive coefficients and nondegeneracy and transversality conditions at the multipliers +1 and -1. We prove equivalence under regular changes of implicit representation and exact invariance under cyclic relabelling when the reduction data are transported consistently.
papers.title_ja: 暗黙的な離散力学系の周期軌道に対するリアプノフ・シュミット縮約
papers.summary_ja: 任意の有限次元における暗黙的な離散力学系の周期軌道について、分岐方程式を導出する。周期的リアプノフ・シュミット縮約を用いることで、乗数+1および-1における非退化条件と横断性条件を再帰的に係数として表現する。さらに、暗黙的表現の正則な変化下での等価性と、縮約データを一貫して輸送した場合の周期的再ラベリングに対する厳密な不変性を証明する。
papers.relevance_reason: 軌道力学の数学的基礎だが、MLや高速化手法との直接的な接点がないため中程度

papers.title: Beyond GNSS: Leveraging LEO Satellite Signals of Opportunity for Doppler Positioning
papers.summary: Large constellations of low Earth orbit (LEO) satellites provide ubiquitous global connectivity; yet, their rapid motion introduces significant Doppler shift effects. While challenging for communication, these effects can be leveraged for precise user terminal (UT) positioning, particularly in GNSS-denied environments where traditional satellite-based navigation struggles. Unlike GNSS, most LEO satellites lack dedicated navigation signals, motivating signals-of-opportunity (SOPs) approaches that repurpose existing LEO signals and use publicly available two-line element (TLE) files for orbital information, although ephemeris errors can limit accuracy. This article explores the fundamental principles, challenges, and enabling technologies for LEO-based Doppler shift positioning, highlighting its advantages over conventional non-Doppler methods, and discussing future research directions. Furthermore, to facilitate realistic and reproducible performance evaluation beyond stochastic modeling, we propose SionnaNTN-RT, a ray tracing framework for non-terrestrial network (NTN) built upon Sionna, enabling end-to-end simulation of Doppler-based positioning. Simulation results demonstrate that Doppler-based positioning can achieve high positioning accuracy in both urban and open-sky environments, highlighting its promise for next-generation positioning systems.
papers.title_ja: GNSSを超えて：LEO衛星の機会シグナルを活用したドップラー測位
papers.summary_ja: 低軌道（LEO）衛星の高速移動に伴うドップラーシフトを逆手に取り、GNSSが利用できない環境での高精度測位を実現する手法を提案する。既存の通信信号と公開軌道データ（TLE）を用いた「機会シグナル（SOP）」アプローチの原理と課題を整理し、従来の非ドップラー法との優位性を議論する。さらに、Sionnaベースのレイトレーシングフレームワーク「SionnaNTN-RT」を提案し、都市部や開けた空域でのシミュレーションにより、高い測位精度を実証した。
papers.relevance_reason: 軌道力学と信号処理の交差領域だが、ML活用が薄く直接関連は中程度

papers.title: ODC: Orthogonal Drift Correction for Improved Text-to-Image Semantic Alignment at Inference
papers.summary: Text-to-image models have achieved remarkable success in generating high-quality images from textual descriptions. However, they often struggle with "semantic drift," where the generated output fails to precisely align with complex or nuanced text prompts. While recent approaches have attempted to address semantic errors regarding attribute binding or object presence, there remains a gap for a more holistic method that addresses these issues by directly refining the text embeddings of the initial user prompt. In this work, we introduce Orthogonal Drift Correction (ODC), an inference-time guidance method designed to mitigate semantic drift without requiring model retraining or additional user inputs. ODC guides image generation through a two-stage process. In the first stage, it identifies the semantic drift by evaluating the initially generated image against the user prompt in a shared vision-language embedding space. It then isolates the component of this drift vector that is orthogonal to the prompt's direction and translates it back into text via a vocabulary-based surrogate mechanism. In the second stage, it produces refined text conditioning for a second generation pass by feeding both the initial text embedding and the re-embedded drift representation into an adaptive rank-reduced concept removal module. Our experiments demonstrate that ODC consistently improves prompt-image alignment, increasing CLIP scores by up to 5.4% over the baseline on the COALBench-300 and PartiPrompts benchmarks. Furthermore, on the T2I-CompBench complex subset, ODC improves the average 3-in-1 score by 4.5% over the competing methods. As a plug-and-play module, ODC offers a practical and efficient method for improving the reliability of text-to-image models. Code is available at https://github.com/kasrakamali/ODC.
papers.title_ja: ODC: 推論時の直交ドリフト補正によるテキストから画像への意味整合性の向上
papers.summary_ja: テキストから画像生成モデルにおける「セマンティックドリフト」を、モデルの再学習なしに推論時に補正する手法ODCを提案する。視覚言語埋め込み空間内でドリフトベクトルを特定し、プロンプト方向に直交する成分を分離・変換することで、より正確なテキスト条件を生成する。この2段階のプロセスにより、COALBench-300やPartiPromptsなどのベンチマークでCLIPスコアが最大5.4%向上した。プラグアンドプレイ型のモジュールとして、既存モデルの信頼性を効率的に高める実用的な手法である。
papers.relevance_reason: 推論時の効率化と評価ベンチマークへの言及があるが、対象が画像生成でありLLMや軌道力学とは異なるため中程度。

papers.title: HamFormer: A Hamiltonian Flow-based SE(3)-Transformer for Conformation Optimization
papers.summary: The Transformer architecture plays a central role in modern deep learning, and its SE(3)-equivariant variants have been widely applied to molecular conformation modeling and optimization. Given its importance, many methods attempt to interpret and improve the Transformer through the lens of dynamics. However, they mainly focus on a single attention head rather than the full Transformer architecture and seldom consider SE(3)-equivariance in their proposed models. In this study, we propose an improved SE(3)-Transformer architecture, called HamFormer, which revisits the design of SE(3)-Transformer through the lens of Hamiltonian flow. In particular, we define a parametrized Hamiltonian flow in the phase space of position and velocity, corresponding to optimizing an energy functional that combines an optimal transport-based potential with a damped momentum. The Lie-Trotter splitting framework of the Hamiltonian flow leads to the proposed HamFormer architecture, whose feedforward computation achieves the optimization step of the proposed energy functional. Furthermore, we combine HamFormer with Equivariant Graph Neural Network (EGNN), build a new model for molecular conformation optimization. Extensive experiments on molecular ground-state conformation prediction show that HamFormer provides a strong and physically interpretable surrogate for classic SE(3)-Transformer and generally outperforms state-of-the-art competitors.
papers.title_ja: HamFormer: 分子構造最適化のためのハミルトニアンフローベースのSE(3)-Transformer
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、ハミルトニアンフローの視点からSE(3)-Transformerの設計を再考し、物理的に解釈可能な改良型アーキテクチャ「HamFormer」を提案する。位相空間におけるパラメトリックなハミルトニアンフローを定義し、Lie-Trotter分割を用いてフィードフォワード計算を最適化ステップとして定式化している。さらにEGNNと組み合わせることで、分子の基底状態構造予測において既存の最先端手法を上回る性能を示した。
papers.relevance_reason: 物理情報モデルとサロゲートモデルの手法だが、対象が分子構造であり軌道力学ではないため

papers.title: InformedXRD: Reproducible Benchmarks and Physics-Informed Evaluation for Powder Diffraction Symmetry Classification
papers.summary: Machine learning for powder diffraction (PXRD) symmetry classification is being trained at scale, yet the field lacks a common evaluation standard: papers report results on different subsets of experimental archives, with different target taxonomies, preprocessing, and metrics, and published models are rarely released in a form that permits rescoring. We present InformedXRD, an evaluation framework with three parts: (i) a machine-readable mapping from 230 space groups to 99 extinction groups, the finest classes powder diffraction can identify from systematic absences alone; (ii) a benchmark-construction method whose inclusion rules are specified as code and reproduce from a frozen snapshot, instantiated as RRUFF-473, RRUFF-325, and, as a small example, opXRD-98; (iii) a reporting protocol with prior-only frequency baselines, a label-permutation test, a hierarchy-aware error metric on the condensed translationengleiche subgroup graph, and stratified evaluation. We build on the mapping, RRUFF benchmarks, subgroup graph, and four ViT checkpoints released in our earlier work (Baggett et al., 2026). Using these checkpoints, a 1D residual CNN, and six architectures trained under the XRDBench recipe (Cao et al., 2025), we show that evaluation design changes what conclusions are justified: paired tests point in different directions at Top-1 and Top-5; paired Top-k tests do not separate the three leading XRDBench models, while hierarchy-aware analysis describes error distance and direction across all six; an input-blind frequency predictor matches the models on aggregate Top-k, yet a label-permutation test still detects pattern-specific evidence; and stratified analysis exposes a label-entropy confound that aggregate accuracy hides. All mapping tables, benchmark code, scripts, and checkpoints are released as shared infrastructure for PXRD-ML evaluation.
papers.title_ja: InformedXRD: 粉末回折対称性分類のための再現可能なベンチマークと物理情報評価
papers.summary_ja: 粉末回折（PXRD）による対称性分類における機械学習モデルの評価基準が統一されていない問題に対し、再現可能なベンチマーク構築手法と物理情報に基づく評価プロトコルを提案する。230の空間群を99の消滅群にマッピングする機械可読な対応表を提供し、RRUFF-473などの凍結スナップショットから再現可能なベンチマークを定義した。階層構造を考慮した誤差指標やラベル置換テストを用いることで、従来の集約精度では見えないモデル間の差異やラベルエントロピーによる混同を明らかにした。ViTやCNNなど複数アーキテクチャでの検証を通じて、評価設計が結論に与える影響を実証し、コードやチェックポイントを公開した。

papers.title: Surrogate Losses for Fairness-Aware Classification: Fisher Consistency and Calibration
papers.summary: Fairness-aware classification seeks to balance predictive accuracy and fairness across demographic groups. Although surrogate losses facilitate the optimization of fairness-aware objectives, it remains unclear when minimizing these losses yields optimal decisions under the original fairness-aware risk. This paper investigates the statistical validity of surrogate-based fairness-aware classification under demographic parity and equal opportunity, considering both attribute-blind and attribute-aware settings. We introduce fairness-aware Fisher consistency and characterize it through conditions on the derivatives of the surrogate losses. The characterization shows that consistency depends not only on the individual loss functions but also on their interaction within the fairness-regularized objective. We further establish a calibration inequality that relates the excess fairness-aware risk to the excess surrogate risk, providing a quantitative connection between surrogate optimization and the original classification objective. Numerical experiments illustrate how deviations from the consistency conditions affect fairness-aware excess risk and how the regularization parameter influences the well-posedness of surrogate optimization. An application to consumer credit default prediction demonstrates that appropriately calibrated fairness regularization can substantially reduce demographic disparities while maintaining predictive performance.
papers.title_ja: 公平性考慮分類のためのサロゲート損失：フィッシャー一貫性とキャリブレーション
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、人口統計学的平等や機会均等の制約下における公平性考慮分類のサロゲート損失の統計的妥当性を分析する。サロゲート損失の最小化が元の公平性リスクの最適解に収束するための「公平性考慮フィッシャー一貫性」を定義し、損失関数の導関数条件を通じて特徴付けを行った。さらに、サロゲートリスクと元のリスクの差を定量的に結びつけるキャリブレーション不等式を導出する。消費者信用デフォルト予測への適用実験により、適切な公平性正則化が予測性能を維持しつつ人口統計的格差を大幅に削減できることを示した。

papers.title: OmniPiano: Diverse Dexterous Piano-Playing Challenges for Standard, Robust, Safe, and Multi-Agent RL
papers.summary: Dexterous robotic manipulation remains a major challenge in robotics, exemplified by piano playing, which requires coordinated control of fingers and provides a demanding testbed for reinforcement learning (RL). Although previous work established a benchmark for robotic piano playing, it is restricted to two hands and does not support unified evaluation. To address this gap, we introduce OmniPiano, a benchmark that provides one to up to five Shadow Hands and supports standard, robust, safe, and multi-agent RL within a shared piano-playing task family. OmniPiano is developed for scalable and diverse piano-playing tasks with configurable perturbations, explicit safety constraints, and decentralized cooperation settings. Particularly, to facilitate usability and extendability, OmniPiano adopts a highly modular design and provides comprehensive tasks to support RL study of task performance, robustness, safety, and cooperation in dexterous control. With at least 912 task settings and 36 baseline algorithms, OmniPiano further incorporates LLM-based agents to broaden the evaluation scope and reveal new insights. Extensive evaluations show that state-of-the-art RL algorithms and frontier LLM-based agents still struggle on challenging piano-playing tasks, even under standard RL settings, highlighting substantial room for improvement in dexterous control. The code, dataset, tutorial, and demo are available at https://sail-research-lab.github.io/omnipiano/.
papers.title_ja: OmniPiano: 標準的・頑健・安全・マルチエージェント強化学習のための多様な器用なピアノ演奏チャレンジ
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、ロボットの器用な操作能力を評価するためのベンチマーク「OmniPiano」を提案する。1〜5本のシャドウハンドを用いたピアノ演奏タスクを統一し、標準的な性能だけでなく、頑健性、安全性、マルチエージェント協調といった多様な観点からの評価を可能にする。LLMベースのエージェントも統合し、既存の最先端強化学習アルゴリズムやLLMエージェントが依然として困難なタスクに直面していることを示す。

papers.title: Statistical Inference under Performativity: From Policy Feedback to Self-Evolving Systems
papers.summary: Performativity arises when prediction-informed decisions change the data-generating process, creating feedback between deployment and learning. This phenomenon occurs in policy-making and in self-evolving AI systems that shape their own future training data. Statistical inference is challenging because estimation errors in earlier predictors affect subsequent data distributions and propagate into later updates. We develop an end-to-end framework for statistical inference under performativity. For repeated risk minimization and repeated gradient descent, we establish central limit theorems at fixed deployment rounds and derive covariance recursions that capture both current-round sampling variation and uncertainty inherited from earlier deployments. We develop consistent covariance estimators using policy perturbations and score matching. These results can yield asymptotically valid confidence regions for population iterates and the performative stable point. We further extend prediction-powered inference to this dynamic setting, combining labeled observations with predictions on additional unlabeled data to improve statistical efficiency. We evaluate our framework in synthetic, semi-synthetic educational, and self-evolving large language model routing settings. Our experiments demonstrate that ignoring propagated uncertainty can lead to substantial undercoverage even after repeated retraining. Together, these results provide statistical tools for learning systems that help determine the distributions from which they learn. Our work establish a complete statistical inference under performativity, introducing new challenges and inference settings that we believe will provide substantial value to policy-making, statistics, and machine learning.
papers.title_ja: 実行可能性（Performativity）下での統計的推論：政策フィードバックから自己進化システムへ
papers.summary_ja: 予測に基づく意思決定がデータ生成過程を変化させ、学習とデプロイメントの間にフィードバックが生じる「実行可能性」問題に対する統計的推論フレームワークを提案する。反復リスク最小化や勾配降下法において、中央極限定理を確立し、過去のデプロイメントから継承される不確実性を捉える共分散再帰式を導出する。さらに、ラベル付きデータと予測値を組み合わせた予測駆動推論を動的設定に拡張し、統計的効率を向上させる手法を示す。合成データや自己進化LLMルーティング設定での実験により、伝播する不確実性を無視すると信頼区間のカバー率が大きく低下することを示し、自己進化AIシステムの信頼性評価に貢献する。

papers.title: Scaling Trusted Autonomy: Towards Generally Capable Verifiable Robots
papers.summary: Robots powered by foundation models are increasingly able to interpret open-ended language, recognize unfamiliar objects, and operate across diverse environments. Yet broader capability does not establish that a robot has understood a request, that its actions will produce the intended effects, or that its internal representation still corresponds to reality. Classical symbolic planning provides explicit structure for composition and verification, but traditionally depends on hand-engineered skills and representations. Learned policies can broaden the robot's repertoire, but provide weak guarantees about what will happen and why. This thesis argues that scaling trusted autonomy requires a neurosymbolic approach that unifies the generality of learned models with symbolic structure for robust robot behavior. It explores three complementary directions. First, LIMP uses foundation models and spatial reasoning to ground natural-language instructions in explicit task constraints and instruction-specific semantic maps, enabling task-and-motion planning while exposing the robot's interpretation for inspection. Second, REALM maintains an editable, photorealistic 3D Gaussian scene, predicts the consequences of planned manipulation, and locally reconciles the scene so that subsequent instructions obtain their grounding and planning geometry from an updated state. Third, PACTS learns visuomotor skills that jointly generate action trajectories and predictions of their symbolic effects, supporting skill composition, progress monitoring, and recovery through replanning. Together, these contributions preserve explicit structure for reasoning and verification while broadening how it is obtained, providing a foundation for generally capable robots whose behavior can be assessed under the assumptions of their models.
papers.title_ja: 信頼できる自律性のスケーリング：汎用的で検証可能なロボットへ
papers.summary_ja: 基盤モデルを活用したロボットの汎用性と、行動の検証可能性・信頼性を両立させるためのニューロシンボリックアプローチを提案する。LIMP、REALM、PACTSという3つの手法を通じて、自然言語指示の明示的な制約化、編集可能な3Dシーンによる結果予測、および視覚運動スキルとシンボリック効果予測の統合を実現する。これにより、ロボットの内部表現と現実の対応関係を維持しつつ、行動の解釈と検証を可能にする。

papers.title: A Generalized Sparse Fuzzy Clustering Framework with Automated Cluster Cardinality Estimation Ability
papers.summary: Fuzzy clustering provides a robust framework for handling ambiguous and overlapping data boundaries, yet its traditional formulation generates entirely dense membership assignments that limit noise resilience and prevent estimating the true number of clusters, when it is unknown. To address these limitations, we introduce in this paper the Generalized Sparse Fuzzy Clustering (GSFC) framework, which incorporates a continuous sparsity penalty into the fuzzy objective function. Because closed-form solutions are precluded by the simultaneous presence of fuzzifier and sparsity exponents, we propose an efficient primal-dual bisection search coupled with specialized analytic pathways to rigorously enforce the partition constraint while organically driving trace memberships to exact zero. This mathematically enforced sparsity empowers the algorithm to autonomously estimate the true number of clusters by dynamically pruning redundant clusters, provided that it is initialized by a larger than the true number of clusters. Furthermore, we integrate a virtual noise sink to insulate outliers from the rest of the data points. The usage of the proposed framework is also extended to line segment detection. Extensive empirical evaluations across synthetic toy datasets, high-noise geometric stress tests, and real-world benchmarks (UCI wine dataset and hyperspectral images) demonstrate that GSFC effectively exceeds conventional fuzzy benchmarks while autonomously resolving cluster cardinality. Additionally, it significantly outperforms existing sparse possibilistic and probabilistic soft-clustering alternatives in line detection tasks.
papers.title_ja: 自動クラスタ数推定機能を備えた汎用スパースファジークラスタリングフレームワーク
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、ファジークラスタリングの課題である密な所属度とクラスタ数推定の困難さを解決するため、連続的なスパースペナルティを導入したGSFCフレームワークを提案する。閉形式解が存在しないため、プライマルデュアル二分探索と解析的経路を用いて分割制約を厳密に満たしつつ、冗長なクラスタを動的に剪定することで真のクラスタ数を自動推定する。さらに仮想ノイズシンクを統合し、外れ値への耐性を高めた。合成データや高スペクトル画像などでの評価により、従来のファジークラスタリングやスパース確率モデルを上回る性能と、線分検出タスクにおける優位性を示した。
papers.relevance_reason: 機械学習手法全般に該当するが、LLMや軌道力学との直接的な関連は薄い。

papers.title: Interpretable structural temperature scaling for calibrating graph neural networks and point-cloud segmentation
papers.summary: Graph-aware calibrators make graph neural networks (GNNs) more trustworthy by predicting a temperature for each node, usually with auxiliary networks whose decisions are hard to inspect. We propose Interpretable Structural Temperature Scaling (ISTS), a twelve-parameter linear model that sets each node's temperature from named descriptors of its confidence, neighbourhood and closeness to labelled nodes, so every temperature traces back to descriptor contributions. ISTS preserves predictions, and cross-validated regularisation lets the calibration data decide how far the model departs from temperature scaling (TS). Its explanations are faithful at the level of node groups: on test nodes, ISTS softens groups that a global temperature leaves over-confident and sharpens under-confident ones (Spearman correlation 0.67 over 246 groups). On seven graphs with two backbones and eleven baselines, ISTS has the best average rank in negative log-likelihood (NLL) and Brier score and lowers NLL relative to TS by 1.8%, more than twice the gain of an identically fitted entropy-based temperature. It ranked first again on four held-out graphs under a protocol fixed in advance. From about 100 calibration nodes on, ISTS is a cheap and inspectable choice, and on point-cloud segmentation it significantly improves NLL, Brier score and the ranking of points for rejection.
papers.title_ja: グラフニューラルネットワークと点群セグメンテーションのキャリブレーションのための解釈可能な構造温度スケーリング
papers.summary_ja: 本研究では、グラフニューラルネットワーク（GNN）の信頼性を高めるための新しいキャリブレーション手法「ISTS」を提案する。ISTSは12パラメータの線形モデルであり、ノードの信頼度や近傍構造などの記述子から温度を決定することで、予測結果を保持しつつ解釈可能性を確保する。7つのグラフデータセットでの評価により、ISTSはNLLやBrierスコアにおいて既存手法を上回り、特に点群セグメンテーションにおいて拒否判定のランキングを大幅に改善した。約100個のキャリブレーションノードから有効であり、低コストで検査可能な手法として実務応用が期待される。

papers.title: The Prior-Force Family of Implicit Denoiser Priors and Its Decisions in Linear Inverse Problems
papers.summary: Implicit priors given by Gaussian denoisers successfully regularize a wide range of inverse problems in approaches such as plug-and-play (PnP), regularization by denoising (RED) and score-based methods. Such a prior depends on the noise level, and how it selects among signals consistent with the data remains largely uncharacterized. To put implicit and explicit priors on the same footing, we define the prior-force family $W_t=t^{-1}(D_t^{-1}-I)$ of any Gaussian denoiser $D_t$ at noise variance $t>0$ (inverse in the graph sense), the normalized denoising residual as an operator on clean signals. At a common effective prior weight, the equilibrium equations differ only in their prior terms: PnP uses $W_t$, RED/score-based methods the score force (the normalized residual as an operator on noisy inputs), and maximum a posteriori (MAP) estimation the MAP force (the negative log-prior gradient). For the minimum mean-square error (MMSE) denoisers of a prior $\pi$, we compare the corresponding energies at three levels. Without observation, raising the noise level favors PnP minima that retain more posterior variance. On signals consistent with the data, the leading-order PnP energy for separated modes is the proximal hull of the MAP energy, which lets PnP select signals between modes; modes of equal data fit are ranked by peak height at small noise levels and by mass at large ones. For recovery, $W_t$ at the truth bounds the local bias, and an oracle noise level balances this bias against denoiser error. These results show that the noise level is a parameter of the prior rather than a step size. Experiments with exact priors support these predictions, including the mixture components that PnP selects on unseen data.
papers.title_ja: 暗黙のデノイザー事前分布ファミリーと線形逆問題におけるその決定
papers.summary_ja: ガウスデノイザーに基づく暗黙の事前分布が、Plug-and-Play (PnP) や RED などの逆問題手法においてどのように信号を選択するかを理論的に分析する。ノイズレベルはステップサイズではなく事前分布のパラメータとして機能し、PnP は MAP 推定とは異なるエネルギー構造（プロキシマルハル）を持つことを示す。これにより、データに一致する信号の間で PnP がどのように解を決定し、ノイズレベルが後方分散やバイアスに与える影響を定式化する。厳密な事前分布を用いた実験により、これらの理論的予測が裏付けられた。
papers.relevance_reason: 逆問題の理論的基礎だが、LLMや軌道力学との直接の関連は薄い

papers.title: Model Collapse Is Avoidable Even as Real Data Vanishes: A Sharp Criterion for Iterative Gaussian Estimation
papers.summary: Large generative models are commonly trained on data collected from the open web, which may contain data produced by previous generations of the same model. Previous work has shown that recursively training on model-generated data can progressively degrade model performance, a phenomenon known as model collapse. Yet, generative models continue to improve dramatically over time. Existing theory suggests that this is enabled by the availability of new real data at each iteration, kept separate from generated data. However, exact separation is not realistic, and uncurated data is still commonly used. We bridge this gap by considering a more realistic setup in which real and generated data are not handled differently during training. Specifically, we present a comprehensive theoretical study of iterative estimation of the mean and covariance of a multivariate Gaussian distribution. At each iteration, samples are drawn from a mixture of the real data distribution and the estimated distribution from the previous iteration, but are used indistinguishably. We provide a single equivalent condition for consistency of the mean and covariance estimators in Euclidean norms, and convergence to zero of the expected squared 2-Wasserstein distance between the estimated and true distributions. Using this result, we show that consistency holds, i.e., model collapse is avoided, for any fixed real data fraction above zero, and even for a fraction that vanishes across iterations, provided it does not vanish too quickly. However, more real data (or data curation) remains important at practical finite times: the convergence rate of the mean estimator deteriorates as the real data fraction approaches zero. We support our results with an empirical investigation of the theoretical setup, and with experiments on iterative training of a diffusion model on CIFAR-10 that correlate with our theory.
papers.title_ja: 実データが消失してもモデル崩壊は回避可能：反復ガウス推定のための鋭い基準
papers.summary_ja: 生成モデルを反復的に学習させる際の「モデル崩壊」現象について、実データと生成データが区別なく混在する現実的な設定で理論的に分析した。多変量ガウス分布の平均と分散の反復推定において、実データの割合がゼロを超えていれば一貫性が保たれ、崩壊は回避できることを示した。ただし、実データ割合が減少すると収束速度は低下するため、実務的な有限時間ではデータキュレーションや十分な実データが依然として重要である。拡散モデルを用いた実験により、理論的な予測と実測結果の相関を確認した。
papers.relevance_reason: LLMの学習安定性に関わるが、軌道力学やサロゲートモデルとは無関係

papers.title: Outstrumental Variable Regression
papers.summary: Estimating the causal effect of a treatment $X$ on an outcome $Y$ from observational data in the presence of unobserved confounding requires additional structure or assumptions. Existing identification strategies such as instrumental variable regression exploit exogenous variation in only the treatment. We show that the causal effect can also be identified if the outcome mechanism varies across a finite set of environments, even if the treatment distribution is unchanged. Concretely, we introduce Outstrumental Variable Regression (OVR), which proceeds in three steps: (i) compute the conditional expectation of $Y$ given $X$ in each environment; (ii) form the vector of differences in these conditional expectations between all environments and a reference environment (we call this vector contrast); and (iii) regress $Y$ on $X$ while adjusting for the contrast and environment. We prove that this yields the true causal effect if the following two conditions hold: inclusion restriction, i.e., the contrast determines the conditional confounding bias; and positivity, i.e., the treatment varies sufficiently strongly after adjustment. We prove that a finite-sample version of OVR is consistent under regularity conditions and demonstrate the procedure's effectiveness on synthetic and real-world data.
papers.title_ja: アウトストルメンタル変数回帰
papers.summary_ja: 観測データにおける未観測交絡因子が存在する場合の因果効果推定手法「OVR」を提案する。従来のツール変数回帰が処置の外生変動を利用するのに対し、本手法は結果メカニズムが有限個の環境間で変化することを活用する。各環境での条件期待値の差（コントラスト）を計算し、これを調整変数として回帰分析を行うことで因果効果を識別する。包含制限とポジティブ性の条件下で真の因果効果が得られることを証明し、合成データおよび実データで有効性を示した。
papers.relevance_reason: 因果推論の手法であり、ML全般に関わるが軌道力学やLLM特化ではないため中程度

papers.title: OCELOT: Planetary-Scale Species Distribution Modeling with Satellite Foundation Embeddings
papers.summary: Large-scale repositories of species observations now contain billions of occurrence records from around the world, but these sightings cluster heavily in human-accessible areas. Existing models use only a small fraction of these records and are not evaluated on extrapolating to remote, unvisited regions--where species distribution models can be used as geographic priors to help classify data from camera traps and acoustic recorders. We scale relative occurrence species distribution models by training a multimodal implicit neural representation network called OCELOT that fuses spatial coordinates with satellite foundation embeddings on two orders of magnitude more observations than previous work: 2 billion GBIF records across 100,000 taxa. Scaling to this regime requires co-designing the data pipeline, taxonomic representation, loss formulation, and model architecture: spatiotemporal thinning and sub-linear cell sampling correct for spatial redundancy and observer bias, while an additive taxonomic readout shares representations across species, genera, and families to improve predictions for rare taxa. To evaluate performance in remote areas, we benchmark geographic extrapolation using the NDCG metric on spatial block holdouts up to 600 km. Satellite foundation embeddings improve extrapolation by 51% over coordinate-only models and outperform classical bioclimatic rasters. The resulting model also matches or outperforms existing baselines on established interpolation benchmarks, demonstrating that optimizing for geographic extrapolation does not compromise in-distribution accuracy.
papers.title_ja: OCELOT: 衛星基盤埋め込みを用いた惑星規模の種分布モデリング
papers.summary_ja: OCELOTは、空間座標と衛星基盤埋め込みを融合する多モーダル暗黙ニューラル表現ネットワークであり、20億件のGBIF記録を用いて種分布モデルを訓練する。観測バイアスや空間冗長性を補正するデータパイプラインと、希少種への汎化を高める分類学的読み出し機構を設計した。地理的外挿性能をNDCG指標で評価し、座標のみを用いたモデル比で51%向上させることを示した。既存の補間ベンチマークでも同等以上の性能を発揮し、外挿最適化が分布内精度を損なわないことを実証している。
papers.relevance_reason: ニューラル表現と大規模データ処理の手法は関連するが、対象が生態学であり軌道力学やLLM推論とは直接無関係。

papers.title: A Framework for Task-Agnostic Counterfactual Fairness in Transformers through Activation Steering
papers.summary: Bias in transformer-based models is a growing concern as these architectures become more prevalent in automated decision-making systems, such as prediction models for hiring, lending, and clinical treatment recommendation. Mechanistic interpretability (MI) is a growing body of work that measures meaningful causal effects of activations on model output by identifying human-interpretable features encoded in model activations. When such features correspond to sensitive attributes, they provide a direct way to quantify the bias those attributes introduce and to causally intervene to mitigate it. However, counterfactual fairness (CF) methods have not been systematically adapted to this setting of intervening on interpretable mechanisms in transformers. We propose a framework, Mechanistic Interpretability for Counterfactual Fairness (MICF), that utilizes MI tools to reformulate CF constraints in terms of transformer activations, unifying former approaches into a single pipeline for fairness analysis in transformers. MICF does not require a prior causal model or specific transformer architecture. We evaluate MICF on real-world tabular data and show that CF can be improved across different prediction tasks.
papers.title_ja: 活性化ステアリングによるTransformerにおけるタスク非依存の反事実的公平性フレームワーク
papers.summary_ja: Transformerモデルのバイアス対策として、メカニスティック解釈性（MI）ツールを用いた新しいフレームワーク「MICF」を提案する。本手法は、モデルの活性化（アクティベーション）に対する因果的介入を通じて反事実的公平性（CF）の制約を再定式化し、従来のアプローチを単一のパイプラインに統合する。事前の因果モデルや特定のアーキテクチャを必要とせず、実世界の表形式データを用いた評価により、異なる予測タスクにおいて公平性が向上することを示した。
